**地缘冲突重燃，市场风险偏好骤降**

过去24小时，美伊在霍尔木兹海峡的军事对峙急剧升级——美国对伊朗发动空袭，特朗普宣布停火“结束”，全球股市应声下跌：标普500收于7,482.71点，CAC 40跌至8,252.66点。地缘溢价迅速传导至原油和避险资产，同时中国A股与欧洲防务板块出现分化。在宏观压力之下，各市场也浮现出结构性的内部机遇：美股资金开始向低估的Mag 7以外板块轮动，中国养老资金大举涌入科技股，欧洲则面临AI通胀与央行政策的双重博弈。

economy.en:
Geopolitical shockwaves from renewed US-Iran hostilities dominated global markets in the last 24 hours, with the S&P 500 sliding to 7,482.71 after President Trump declared the ceasefire 'over' and the Pentagon launched airstrikes against Iran following an attack on a container ship in the Strait of Hormuz. European benchmarks also fell, while inflation fears resurfaced amid supply-side risks. In China, elderly retail investors are piling into tech stocks, while German automakers suffer a historic sales slump. The ECB faces renewed inflation pressure, and Hong Kong is quietly building a gold-and-yuan network to bypass dollar stablecoins.

- [U.S. launches airstrikes against Iran after Tehran attacks container ship in Hormuz](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/us-airstrikes-iran-strait-hormuz.html) — The Pentagon confirmed airstrikes after Iran attacked a ship on a US-protected route. The escalation sent safe-haven assets higher and risk assets lower.
- [S&P 500 slips to 7,482.71 as Trump declares US-Iran ceasefire 'over'](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxON3V5WW5BbHQ4MXRFcDNpWlZoa0VTTHpSN3dkVG5tVm1SdURWMHhqWDh0R25SUUtfUS1raVdxMGttSG9KLVJBR3FBYzA3Y0tOamsybzM3eTJoV3lCUXlVNVk4LUpyTHMwRkxFRGI4OXJlUWdVUFk5RUZrT1FFdVlxNUR4MlMyc0wwUF9SM1V5NlNmQ3ZkNGNSWXR4ejI2R1diQ2tFQ01TY0xGUUEyamNnaUgwRlpLaWVvOFJrQ2o1dHo) — The Wall Street benchmark closed lower as renewed hostilities erased optimism from the earlier ceasefire.
- [Tech stocks capture China’s elderly retail investors amid faith in nation’s tech sector](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360225/tech-stocks-capture-chinas-elderly-retail-investors-amid-faith-nations-tech-sector) — Veteran investors, including those in their 70s, are chasing chip and AI stocks, reflecting a speculative but patriotic bet on China's technological ascendancy.
- [Volkswagen China deliveries see 26% drop year on year to lowest point since 2010](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360214/volkswagen-china-deliveries-see-26-drop-year-year-lowest-point-2010) — Local EV brands continue to erode market share; German carmakers face existential pressure in the world's largest auto market.
- [CAC 40 slides to 8,252.66 as renewed US-Iran hostilities rattle European markets](https://news.google.) — The Paris benchmark fell in sympathy with global risk-off sentiment, and the ECB now faces renewed inflation risk from higher energy costs.
- [Hong Kong builds a gold and yuan network that sidesteps dollar stablecoins](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQZms0NkxaM1diN2xQcTYwbENyZ0dUWVZkcnZsdEN2bm5jU2ZvZE5hbi1MMDRvLWJETEhoY2tqZ29QUEZtd290aVRTcUNSUHFJLUhVTThmTGMxemg3b29EX3plVG51X2pKVFpFcWJJX283OTFRRnd3WlRHSFJ1LWp5cldpdzRPZWxrLTdCc0FCaUZQcElIbzg5VGVuQjI5OXBtYnZzcEJlR3JxUGRmYUgxTDNn) — A strategic move to reduce dollar dependence in trade and finance, with implications for global reserve currency dynamics.
- [Goldman Sachs warns the US will bear the brunt of a global AI-induced inflation surge](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPWHYzaTRVOTFBWWo0RlQ1UFpTc3J0VU9Jcy1CRVN3ekYxZ0lTU1VvMW1SeGhrdkp4dEJFZGNlX3dCSGN6NmxtNjJhT0NhSTVZZDBWb3BwMzBjdzNuYWQtQVZ0N2J0c0hyMURwRzlEeVdtM1gyVHVVN0lxSmZKZ2RoM3JUNmVvdWdnM1czcUpaQ092NjQtT2FMQXNTMERNODAzUDNIOFh3SkoxRGM) — AI-driven demand for computing power and data centers could push up core inflation, complicating Fed policy.

**Watch next:** All eyes are on whether the US-Iran conflict will escalate further or stabilise, with potential spikes in oil prices feeding into global inflation. The Fed’s upcoming policy signals from its FOMC minutes will be scrutinised for dovish or hawkish shifts, while China’s technology rally faces a reality check as regulatory risks remain.

society.zh:
今日全球社会新闻呈现多重高烈度冲突与自然灾害交织的态势。伊朗局势骤然升级，美国发动打击后伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡并攻击约旦及海湾国家，中东进入新的危险阶段。欧洲方面，西班牙野火已致12死，波兰总理呼吁纪念二战期间乌克兰民族主义者对波兰人的屠杀，波乌历史裂痕再现。北美多伦多街头节日发生枪击致2死4伤，美国国内政治则因特朗普政府传唤《纽约时报》记者而再起波澜。亚太地区，台风“巴威”登陆中国浙江，近200万人撤离；日本成功试射可重复使用火箭，标志航天能力突破。以下为各区域重点。

- [伊朗战事：美国轰炸伊朗城市，伊朗宣布关闭霍尔木兹海峡并攻击约旦及海湾国家](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/12/iran-war-live-irgc-declares-strait-of-hormuz-closed-over-us-interference?traffic_source=rss) — 中东局势瞬间白热化，霍尔木兹海峡封锁将冲击全球能源市场。
- [多伦多Salsa街头节日枪击致2死4伤](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce3e66e1x3go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 警方称系两人交火，市长谴责“不负责任的暴力”。
- [西班牙野火成该国最致命火灾之一，至少12人遇难，含4名英国人](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 另有23人失踪，高温干旱加剧火势蔓延。
- [波兰总理承诺为二战期间乌克兰民族主义者屠杀波兰人建立纪念碑](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cze94x4361po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 华沙与基辅长期因数十万平民被害事件存在分歧，此举可能影响两国关系。
- [中国一周内第二场台风“巴威”登陆浙江，近200万人撤离](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxd3wkp2rzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 温州处于风暴路径上，防灾压力巨大。
- [印度穆斯林法官因判决14名印度教“牛义警”有罪而面临死亡威胁](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd6e9zq87xvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 法官Tabassum Khan遭遇大规模网络暴力，反映印度社会宗教撕裂。
- [日本成功发射并着陆可重复使用火箭](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQZjE3QW9TMGZSSU8wWkZOZXRzRzE3X3FZUm51Qk8xUFk1MXNvckt5MXdoaFF2dFFUdFdKbEMxRl9NWDU3cXlsSHduVjgyOE9Kc0h2WEppdHpCVWJja1pucDF0cGI3VUZWQnFpUUZfbzh5OHdsT1B1X3hLZVA2bkpsa1V2czhITnFXdVJPbHotYXBNRkNuZ0hDaldxemN2TkFkb2JxMFhn) — 继SpaceX后又一突破，为日本商业航天注入强心针。

**后续观察：** 伊朗-美国对峙短期难以降温，油市及中东安全格局面临重构；欧洲高温野火与历史问题同时发酵；亚太台风季与航天竞赛并行——社会新闻正从单一事件转向多重危机叠加的复杂图景，读者需关注各冲突触点间的连锁反应。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in the Iran-US conflict, with Tehran closing the Strait of Hormuz and launching attacks on Jordan and Gulf states following US bombardment of Iranian cities. This has immediate implications for global energy security and regional stability. Meanwhile, domestic tragedies in Toronto and Spain, fresh typhoon devastation in China, and political flashpoints in Poland, India, and the West Bank round out a volatile news cycle.

- **Iran closes Strait of Hormuz, US launches fresh strikes**: The US bombed Iranian cities including Bandar Abbas and Chabahar; Iran retaliated by closing the Strait of Hormuz and attacking Jordan and Gulf states. Oil markets and global shipping face severe disruption. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9gkpp0dkeo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/12/iran-war-live-irgc-declares-strait-of-hormuz-closed-over-us-interference?traffic_source=rss))
- **Toronto street festival shooting leaves two dead**: An exchange of gunfire between two individuals at the Salsa on St Clair festival wounded four others. Police recovered two firearms. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce3e66e1x3go), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/12/toronto-shooting-two-dead-and-three-injured-as-police-search-for-active-shooter))
- **China's second typhoon in a week makes landfall**: Typhoon Bavi struck eastern Zhejiang, forcing the evacuation of nearly 2 million people. The storm earlier lashed Japan's southern islands. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxd3wkp2rzo), [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQRXRvY3dvSWFhN0ctWDN4dmo3WGZKTVB2YkREdVVtUkZ4ckt0bklDQm5vcGp1clNQWGcycy02eGFQaGRSYTNEbktYQWp2MGZKNlptdDNfdmxkTFAzZ1VHWThSY1Zvd3Q0Z1lhY1ljdmNPc3pRdVFPVnhrbEt3enNGWUVRREM))
- **Polish PM pledges memorial for WW2 'genocide by Ukrainian nationalists'**: Warsaw and Kyiv remain at odds over the Volhynia massacre, adding strain to already complex relations amid the Ukraine war. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cze94x4361po))
- **Muslim judge in India faces death threats after convicting cow vigilantes**: Tabassum Khan sentenced 14 Hindu men in a lynching case, sparking online abuse and highlighting communal tensions. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd6e9zq87xvo))
- **US Democrat Ro Khanna detained by armed Israeli settlers**: The California congressman was held for 90 minutes in the occupied West Bank, underscoring settler impunity and US-Israel tensions. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0qyk9jwq9no))
- **Spain battles one of its deadliest wildfires**: At least 12 killed, 23 missing, and four Britons believed among the victims. The blaze is a stark reminder of climate-driven fire risk in Southern Europe. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo))

**Watch next**: The unfolding Iran crisis will dominate headlines, with Strait of Hormuz closure threatening oil prices and global supply chains. Typhoon impacts in China and Japan will continue to disrupt daily life and economic activity. The Polish WWII memorial announcement may reignite diplomatic friction with Ukraine. On the cultural front, the T. rex fossil auction ($30m pre-sale) could set a record.

military.zh:
过去24小时，全球军事格局呈现多点共振：伊朗与北约在霍尔木兹海峡的对峙持续升级，美军基地遭弹道导弹精准打击；乌克兰对俄黑海舰队发动大规模无人机攻击，亚速海航运中断；南海仲裁案十周年之际，中国强化岛礁管辖并出现声索巴丹群岛的舆论试探；美军加速扩充远程打击弹药库存，同时推进定向能武器与反无人机海战能力。以下为各子专栏详细分析。

- **[伊朗弹道导弹命中约旦美军基地](https://news.google.)**：卫星图像确认，伊朗导弹精确命中新建机库，射程超1000公里，显示伊朗远程精确打击能力提升，对美军中东部署构成新威胁。
- **[乌克兰宣称一夜打击21艘俄油轮](https://news.google.)**：乌克兰远程无人机攻击俄亚速海油轮，迫使俄方暂停顿河-亚速海航运，粮食贸易受冲击。此举意在切断克里米亚与俄本土的陆桥补给线，其战略影响值得关注。
- **[特朗普承认正在权衡对伊朗有限打击](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBVTmdod05sU2VVYjQ1WDRpaWNMTzhHZXpFQ2FvYWJvdnhfb01JTFEtc1BCX0s2UXJHVm1iQkhaSXBuTDBEOTVKeGpSNk1XZFptMTV1QlE0R1VZdHI1dW1vSHZUbw)**：美伊紧张关系处于临界点，有限打击选项可能进一步扩大冲突范围。
- **[南海仲裁案十年：中国官媒建议声索巴丹群岛主权](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1WYS1adkNRRmgyZHNadUF1WjVuSTRMd0tjRDFTbmcwNHh4djEzVXNiVk9Ucm1tRi1rbTlYV3lWV2VTZEJSOW5UYmFmbjlhT0dyOGcwWDZxMDVPcnkxVUYtNXVKS2hrZXBh)**：配合官方强化南海管辖的系列表态，显示中国在南海问题上采取更主动的法律与舆论攻势。
- **[美军计划将LRASM/JASSM产量提高三倍](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/)**：未来5-7年采购超11000枚，反映美军为应对大国冲突（尤其是印太方向）储备远程精确打击弹药。
- **[太平洋岛国拒绝导弹试验](https://news.google.)**：“蓝色大陆”反导试验遭拒，折射出大国在太平洋战略博弈中面临当地社会阻力。

**后续观察**：伊朗与以色列/美国的冲突已超出代理人层面，直接打击美军基地标志战事升级；乌克兰对俄航运的袭击正在改变黑海-亚速海力量平衡；南海仲裁案十周年节点，中国可能进一步采取岛礁建设或执法行动，美菲同盟面临新考验；美军弹药增产与定向能武器研发同步推进，预示未来战争形态的变革。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by escalating multi-front crises: the Iran-Hormuz standoff tests NATO's cohesion, Ukraine's drone strikes threaten Russia's Azov Sea logistics, and China marks a decade since the South China Sea arbitration with renewed territorial claims. Concurrently, the US signals both military restraint (withdrawing F-22s) and industrial mobilization (tripling cruise missile production), while the Pentagon pushes to purge an AI contractor by September. The week ahead demands close monitoring of the Iran-NATO dynamic and Ukraine's Azov campaign.

- **Iran tests NATO's resolve:** The [Hormuz crisis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5uc3l1X242Q1Ribk0temVhMDhGRHMzRzJNa3NCb1pqaldyTmlqWE1GRzhMYXktdVdDbW40d19uMS1VcTcwcWotNVg1R1F5eGFJSFp6T2o4WHpUSEdxZ1M3amxzb2o) and the [Ankara Summit](https://news.google.) are forcing NATO to redefine its strategic posture in a multipolar world, with Iran's ballistic missile strike on a US base in Jordan ([satellite imagery confirms](https://news.google.)) and the [F-22 withdrawal from the Middle East](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNWEd1R0xtVE5EQTU2a3ljOVdfODBYZDRSWVZUXzM2SWEwaHF1clZmUjdwdjRqZVYyM1pwYWdIWVNfdVQ3UmRXLVlDVkxOdll5SmVmNHJ0cENjckFRUFdoeDlZTWRMTFFKNFNPOHVvWFRfZzNoZ0NScTFqUmhvMVV1b09YbHg) highlighting capability gaps.

- **Ukraine strikes deep into Russian logistics:** Kyiv claims [21 Russian tanker vessels hit](https://news.google.) in the Sea of Azov, prompting Russia to [halt Don-Azov shipping](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPX0RKalN2ZXdjSjlpckFybFhMclVwU0h4R2FUd1loU0lDN1hXak1SR1VydUFnaTFkMVI5aWRib184d3ZkWmxpamliZ3UydDU0OVpjdUpSVENRcmxUUmF5TDRrQmVXOGJ3aU9UWUFidEtWUXFnSnJzODZZZk0yWHBlUkk2T0h5SHNxbGFMdm9sajBEOHkwa0pwOA) – a major disruption to grain trade. This could shift Ukraine's strategic position toward severing Russia's Crimea land bridge, as analyzed by [Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE83SnJuWno0SGFhclBaRW5XNW0wX0dtbmNzRENjcmQxVmlDQjNVLUFQbzItVVAySzhpME0tWXU2VnVrQUROZnkxU29obVkwejg).

- **South China Sea arbitration anniversary triggers Chinese assertiveness:** Ten years after the ruling, Chinese state media [reiterates sovereignty claims](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFBsaXRGTzN5SXdIMHZBWUxZQmlFMUlDR2o2WGxzR2I1YmNRODRNXzdMcElxN0JiNVE2TV93dkk4NGV0Sm9jYWFXcDF5czVLRjZVMFd1VlpDNkhUYTFCakRGRGtyZE54NW1q) and a state-run outlet even suggests [claiming sovereignty over the Batan Islands](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1WYS1adkNRRmgyZHNadUF1WjVuSTRMd0tjRDFTbmcwNHh4djEzVXNiVk9Ucm1tRi1rbTlYV3lWV2VTZEJSOW5UYmFmbjlhT0dyOGcwWDZxMDVPcnkxVUYtNXVKS2hrZXBh). Meanwhile, a Chinese military ally (likely North Korea or similar) makes a sudden visit to Beijing, as reported by [NetEase](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5ZWnEzanVSVUhMU3NmQWZKY0xHTVhUVWFUQS1WMXlvS0FfeEJXQWVWUG80NW1rejNBdWN1aEY4N2J4SEJJcmpPTi1xRHhIYjJFSW5LZlFqc0xETUZFOTRWamlB).

- **US industrial base races to meet demand:** The Air Force plans to [triple LRASM and JASSM production](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/) to over 11,000 missiles in 5-7 years, and the Pentagon is pursuing [500-kW laser systems for cruise missile defense](https://news.google.). These decisions reflect lessons from Ukraine and the Iran conflict, where missile inventories have been critical.

- **US signals reluctance for full Iran war:** Trump [acknowledges weighing a limited strike](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBVTmdod05sU2VVYjQ1WDRpaWNMTzhHZXpFQ2FvYWJvdnhfb01JTFEtc1BCX0s2UXJHVm1iQkhaSXBuTDBEOTVKeGpSNk1XZFptMTV1QlE0R1VZdHI1dW1vSHZUbw), and the [F-22 withdrawal](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNWEd1R0xtVE5EQTU2a3ljOVdfODBYZDRSWVZUXzM2SWEwaHF1clZmUjdwdjRqZVYyM1pwYWdIWVNfdVQ3UmRXLVlDVkxOdll5SmVmNHJ0cENjckFRUFdoeDlZTWRMTFFKNFNPOHVvWFRfZzNoZ0NScTFqUmhvMVV1b09YbHg) suggests the US is not escalating. However, Iran's successful strike on a Jordan base shows its capability to challenge US airpower, as analyzed by [Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.).

- **Pentagon AI purge accelerates:** The Air Force is [pushing contractors to remove Anthropic by Sept. 1](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/air-force-pushing-contractors-to-purge-anthropic-by-sept-1-memo/), even as the AI company sues. This will disrupt defense AI integration and may set a precedent for tech industry relations.

**Watch next:** Focus on the Strait of Hormuz – traffic is rising despite attacks, but any escalation could reverse that. Also watch Ukraine's Azov campaign for potential land bridge severance. The NATO Ankara summit's concrete outcomes will emerge in coming days.

tech.zh: 今日科技板块摘要：AI领域陷入「安全危机」与「公众抗议」的双重震荡——OpenAI半年内第六位安全负责人出走，旧金山爆发史上最大规模AI抗议；与此同时，产品侧Nopia合成器终于接近量产、Philips更新变砖事故得到补救。HackerNews社区围绕Grok隐私泄露和Scheme唤起经典范式。汽车方面，特斯拉Cybercab仍在停车场打转，BYD主力车型迎来改款。
tech.en:
The tech landscape this week is defined by a dramatic public backlash against AI, internal turmoil at OpenAI, and a mix of product launches and hiccups. Tens of thousands took to San Francisco streets in the largest anti-AI protest in US history, targeting OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind. Meanwhile, OpenAI lost its sixth safety leader in two years, folding the team into broader research. In hardware, Philips scrambled to replace bricked smart hubs after a faulty update, and the long-awaited Nopia synth finally nears retail. Tesla's Cybercab 'employee rides' remain vague, while scientific curiosities—from fluid fracture to long COVID nerve damage—captured the Hacker News community.

- **Historic AI protest disrupts San Francisco**: Hundreds of protesters marched past offices of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind, demanding a moratorium on AI development. The rally, covered by [Mission Local](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQTTN6VzVIY0NldnZ2dW1WLVZCM2FaeUJVbW9IRXIwNVBkcGJZWTNZYjRfLXhFdTcyaVVNb04zclNHMnROVE1FYy1CWVBVM2xBd09XaVBlRERLd1g4RWRxak1hZDRYODRWOFlHMHpiM1RxcERrbVRza3Bya2JZTXpsVWdKdjlZVlM2NFE) and [Daily Cal](https://news.google.), this is a clear signal of growing public distrust.
- **OpenAI's safety exodus continues**: The company's head of safety is leaving as part of a reorganization, according to [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2212941/openai-head-of-safety-leaving-company-reorganization/), marking the sixth such departure in two years. A think tank report also warns the [global AI industry falls short on safety](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxPcHd6MnFITGRUeGVFVzZPVWgyY0lYeVctakxaMUptajBld1BfV0JIZDd4Ny1Lc1NXeGdzdWRFMlkxVEZ0eXRGVFl2NlBxZlFTOWFqOWh4V2plMzBSYVZ1MXNxTE9jUks3Snl2TlJMRERNMjdtUEgtS3hCc3Y0OUpnVzUtLW9TSWk5bm8wNXJCVU9idDRrMHVLcDltcHA0c3Z5TlE).
- **Philips offers free replacements after update bricks smart hubs**: A faulty firmware update bricked thousands of Philips Hue Bridge Pro units. The company is now offering [free replacements](https://www.engadget.com/2212954/philips-free-replacements-hue-bridge-pro-update-bricked-smart-lighting-hubs/) and rolling out a fix. For smart home users, this is a stark reminder of single-point-of-failure risks.
- **Nopia synth is 'basically finished'**: The viral music instrument that wowed the internet in 2023 is nearly ready for market. Creators showed a working prototype to [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/964499/nopia-viral-synth-finished-price-release-demo), promising a launch soon. Expect strong demand from the pro-audio and synth enthusiast communities.
- **Tesla's Cybercab 'employee rides' may be just parking lot shuttles**: Tesla announced that Cybercab employee rides at Giga Texas are “starting soon,” but [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/11/tesla-cybercab-giga-texas-parking-lot/) notes the scope is unclear—likely just driving around a factory lot, not a real robo-taxi service. Investors should temper expectations.
- **Long COVID damages stomach nerves, study finds**: New research published in the International Journal of Infectious Diseases shows that [long COVID can physically damage the nerves controlling the stomach](https://www.ijidonline.com/article/S1201-9712(26)00608-9/fulltext), offering a biological explanation for gastrointestinal symptoms. The study has sparked heavy discussion on Hacker News.
- **AI finds a 15-year-old vulnerability in Linux kernel**: An AI tool discovered a root bug that had been missed for 15 years, as reported by [Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/security-news-this-week-ai-found-a-root-bug-in-linux-that-everyone-missed-for-15-years/). This underscores AI's growing role in cybersecurity, but also raises questions about reliance on automated vulnerability discovery.

**Watch next**: Keep an eye on the fallout from the AI protests—they may pressure lawmakers to reintroduce safety bills. For consumers, monitor Philips’ patch rollout to see if the replacement program runs smoothly. Musicians and producers should watch for Nopia’s official price and release date. Finally, the Cybercab demo could either be a breakthrough or a PR letdown; we’ll know soon.

sports.zh:
世界杯四分之一决赛战罢，英格兰与阿根廷会师半决赛，贝林厄姆加时绝杀挪威，图赫尔批评球队“幸运”；阿尔瓦雷斯助阿根廷1-0瑞士。NBA休赛期波澜再起：文班亚马5年2.52亿顶薪续约马刺，莫兰特交易至开拓者后称“重新开始”，黄蜂送走拉梅洛·鲍尔推进重建，热火内讧——阿德巴约训练中击中希罗头部。CBA方面，上海久事就怀特塞德兴奋剂事件发声明，中国篮协同日表态。NBPA炮轰第二奢侈税线伤害球员。

- [贝林厄姆两球逆转挪威，英格兰加时2-1晋级](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49337503/jude-bellingham-england-norway-world-cup-quarterfinal-semifinals) 并回呛图赫尔批评：我们就是能“肮脏地赢球”。
- [阿根廷加时1-0瑞士，阿尔瓦雷斯绝杀](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49339687/argentina-switzerland-2026-world-cup-julian-alvarez-england) 延续卫冕之旅。
- [文班亚马5年2.52亿顶薪续约马刺](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328757/sources-spurs-victor-wembanyama-reach-252-million-max-extension)，历史第三大新秀续约。
- [莫兰特称交易至开拓者是“重新开始”，欲洗刷“恶人”形象](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49335942/ja-morant-says-joining-trail-blazers-starting-all-again)。
- [黄蜂GM坦言交易鲍尔“最艰难”，但为长期成功](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337303/ball-trade-help-hornets-compete-championships)。
- [热火内讧升级：阿德巴约在拉斯维加斯训练中击中希罗头部](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328387/heat-bam-adebayo-bucks-tyler-herro-got-physical-altercation-las-vegas)。
- [NBPA执行董事称第二奢侈税线迫使球队做出“非篮球决定”](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49329997/nbpa-players-carrying-burden-teams-due-second-apron)。
- [中国篮协、CBA公司与上海久事就怀特塞德兴奋剂事件同日表态](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5XcmxVRHNEa2I3QldxeVRYMTFQNFdHM3lBekt3bVROVE9ZeTM5dlNtQ1A0eTV5c2VrellYQWM5TkhLeDIwWVFsZWlKcW90SnpaSUh5RFIwb2NsRHgtV2d4dEF3)。

后续观察：世界杯半决赛英格兰vs阿根廷将再现经典对决，贝林厄姆能否延续神勇？NBA自由市场尚有莱昂纳德交易、勒布朗去向等悬念；CBA需关注兴奋剂事件后续处罚，以及新赛季备战动态。
sports.en:
The world of sports is dominated by World Cup drama and seismic NBA shifts. England and Argentina booked their semifinal spots in dramatic fashion, while the NBA offseason saw Victor Wembanyama sign a historic $252M extension and a shocking physical altercation between former Heat teammates. Meanwhile, the tragic death of South African international Jayden Adams at 25 casts a somber note. Here are the key developments from the last 24 hours.

- **World Cup Semifinals Set**: [Jude Bellingham](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49337503/jude-bellingham-england-norway-world-cup-quarterfinal-semifinals) scored twice, including an extra-time winner, as England came from 1-0 down to beat Norway 2-1. The match was marred by controversy over a possible spidercam interference on England's equalizer, which [FIFA denied](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49337953/england-norway-world-cup-goal-ball-camera-cable-jude-bellingham). Argentina edged Switzerland 1-0 on a [Julián Álvarez extra-time goal](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49339687/argentina-switzerland-2026-world-cup-julian-alvarez-england), setting up a heavyweight clash with England.
- **Wembanyama Lands Mega Extension**: The Spurs and Victor Wembanyama agreed to a [five-year, $252 million max rookie extension](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328757/sources-spurs-victor-wembanyama-reach-252-million-max-extension), the third-largest rookie extension in NBA history, locking in the franchise cornerstone.
- **Hornets Trade LaMelo Ball**: Charlotte GM Jeff Peterson called moving Ball the ["most difficult" decision](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337303/ball-trade-help-hornets-compete-championships), but one aimed at building sustained championship contention.
- **Tyler Herro and Bam Adebayo Altercation**: Sources confirm [Adebayo struck Herro in the head](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328387/heat-bam-adebayo-bucks-tyler-herro-got-physical-altercation-las-vegas) during a Las Vegas practice court scuffle, a stunning development between former Heat teammates.
- **Ja Morant Embraces Fresh Start**: After being traded to Portland, Morant said he is ready to ["start fresh"](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49335942/ja-morant-says-joining-trail-blazers-starting-all-again) and shed his "bad guy" image.
- **Tragic Loss: Jayden Adams Dies at 25**: South Africa and Sundowns midfielder [Jayden Adams passed away](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49333373/south-africa-midfielder-jayden-adams-dies-aged-25-weeks-world-cup-appearance), a week after playing in the World Cup.
- **Italy Rebuild with Maldini & Leonardo**: The Italian federation hired [Paolo Maldini as technical director and Leonardo as advisor](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49336670/italy-tap-paolo-maldini-leonardo-technical-director-advisor-roles) to overhaul the national team.

**Watch next**: The England-Argentina semifinal on July 14 promises a tactical battle between Bellingham's relentless drive and Álvarez's clutch finishing. In the NBA, the second-apron debate heats up as the NBPA pushes back, and the LeBron James free agency saga continues with the Warriors as a surprise suitor.

entertainment.zh: 过去24小时，全球娱乐界动静纷呈：欧美方面，Jay-Z在洋基球场以巨星阵容庆祝《The Blueprint》25周年，但限时90分钟的演出令部分歌迷意犹未尽；《Big Brother 28》首播因浮夸火山桥段遭批评，Frankie Grande发声为其“坎普基因”辩护；Patti LuPone的同志游轮连续第二个月被埃及拒之门外，凸显LGBTQ人群出行困境。日韩剧集竞争白热化——SBS《Agent Kim Reactivated》以22.3%全国收视率创下自身新高，JTBC新剧《The Apartment Job》首播即登顶当日有线台冠军；音乐方面，aespa凭“LEMONADE”再下一城，BTS《Life Goes On》MV观看量突破6亿，IU则官宣演员Heo Nam Jun出演新曲MV。中国娱乐圈内部分化明显：一方面，社交媒体热议“无戏可演”的演员回家卖菜，学者沈奕斐对话“不再崇拜明星的年轻人”，行业深度反思浮现；另一方面，导演跑路、明星讨债等内幕爆料频出，而矢野浩二因在广西洪灾中的低调救援使口碑逆转，水军集团落网案更直指粉丝圈层的黑产链条。微博社区则被《功夫女足》的票房与口碑悖论、《百花杀》虞书欣的千万级云包场、以及宋威龙“马场抽签”等话题持续引爆。后续关注：韩剧《Agent Kim Reactivated》能否超越《财阀家的小儿子》成为SBS史上收视第一；Jay-Z后续是否有加场计划；中国影视行业低谷是否促使更多内容创作者转向“深沉电影”路线；以及《百花杀》的包场营销模式是否会成为新常态。
entertainment.en:
Today's entertainment landscape is defined by nostalgia-driven spectacles, K-pop dominance, and Chinese industry controversies. Jay-Z's 25th anniversary 'Blueprint' show at Yankee Stadium drew Eminem and Pharrell but ran a tight 90 minutes, while K-pop acts like aespa and BTS continue to break records. In China, a crackdown on water armies highlights systemic issues, but new dramas like '百花杀' (Baihua Kill) show fan mobilization at scale. Meanwhile, Korean dramas such as 'Agent Kim Reactivated' and 'The Apartment Job' are setting ratings records.

- **[Jay-Z Celebrates ‘The Blueprint’ 25th Anniversary With Eminem, Pharrell Williams and Slick Rick at Yankee Stadium](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/jay-z-celebrates-the-blueprint-eminem-pharrell-slick-rick-1236807102/)** — The streamlined set stayed close to the album, hinting at a purist's approach to live legacy.
- **[aespa Takes 2nd Win For “LEMONADE” On “Music Core”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853870wpp/watch-aespa-takes-2nd-win-for-lemonade-on-music-core-performances-by-babymonster-rescene-and-more)** — The win solidifies their strong comeback; watch for continued chart battles with BABYMONSTER.
- **[BTS’s “Life Goes On” Becomes Their 16th Group MV To Hit 600 Million Views](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853862wpp/btss-life-goes-on-becomes-their-16th-group-mv-to-hit-600-million-views)** — Even during military hiatus, BTS's catalog keeps growing in viewership, demonstrating sustained fan engagement.
- **[“Agent Kim Reactivated” Earns 2nd Highest Ratings Of Any Friday-Saturday Drama In SBS History](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853878wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-earns-2nd-highest-ratings-of-any-friday-saturday-drama-in-sbs-history)** — With a 22.3% rating, this action revenge drama is the top-rated show of 2026 so far.
- **[The Apartment Job Premieres To No. 1 Ratings](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853882wpp/the-apartment-job-premieres-to-no-1-ratings-as-the-husband-rises-to-new-saturday-high)** — Ji Sung's new drama debuts at 4.6% on cable, positioning it as a potential hit.
- **[靠抹黑明星牟利，张凌赫、迪丽热巴都遭殃！中国“水军”集团落网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxORGNfYnhRVE15SVZVSF9iU0dIZkgwaklLT0Fxb05oMXFlSWRoSUV5S1BBTWpWcmw0WkhDMFBYYkdoVzQxeUR4V2FkMXhabm9QeWE0YUJjS0ttdEpIMzhfSUNxVXlFNkF0akJKNG15dERhdHNDbTNqWUxaVW5tVzVuNVc5NGlRekxIUVFLc3RHTVVwdjlza1U2ZjRWdy1GX1pz)** — A 900M-follower influencer was arrested; this marks a major step in regulating online attacks on celebrities.
- **[Emmy Nominations Roundtable: ‘The Pitt’ and ‘Hacks’ Dominate](https://variety.com/2026/tv/awards/emmy-nominations-roundtable-the-pitt-hacks-podcast-1236807336/)** — With 25 noms for 'The Pitt' and record comedy noms for 'Hacks', the race is shaping up; 'Widow’s Bay' and 'Pluribus' are dark horses.

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on IU's upcoming comeback (MV with Heo Nam Jun), the continued rise of 'Agent Kim Reactivated' as it approaches 30% ratings, and the box office performance of '功夫女足' (Kung Fu Women's Football) amid polarized reviews. In the US, the Emmy nominations announcement could reshape the TV landscape.

美股.zh:
**避险与轮动并存，标普500承压**
美伊局势急转直下，标普500收盘跌至7,482.71点，前期强势的Mag 7出现分化。ETF Action策略师指出，投资者应增加对跑输AI板块的标的配置，认为这些领域能在未来半年贡献超额回报。与此同时，伯克希尔哈撒韦B股年内仍跌1.8%，落后标普500逾12个百分点，价值股再度面临质疑。

- [S&P 500下滑至7,482.71，特朗普宣布停火破裂](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxON3V5WW5BbHQ4MXRFcDNpWlZoa0VTTHpSN3dkVG5tVm1SdURWMHhqWDh0R25SUUtfUS1raVdxMGttSG9KLVJBR3FBYzA3Y0tOamsybzM3eTJoV3lCUXlVNVk4LUpyTHMwRkxFRGI4OXJlUWdVUFk5RUZrT1FFdVlxNUR4MlMyc0wwUF9SM1V5NlNmQ3ZkNGNSWXR4ejI2R1diQ2tFQ01TY0xGUUEyamNnaUgwRlpLaWVvOFJrQ2o1dHo)
- [ETF Action建议增持跑输的板块：Mag 7外有望迎来补涨](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/mag-7-and-software-could-boost-portfolio-in-second-half-etf-action.html)
- [伯克希尔B股年内落后标普500达12.4个百分点](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/berkshire-hathaway-gains-ground-but-still-trails-the-sp-500-as-26-enters-second-half.html)
- [新住房法案旨在缓解可负担性，但专家认为效果需时间显现](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/21st-century-road-to-housing-act-homebuyers-sellers.html)

**判断**：地缘风险压制整体估值，但板块轮动信号已现，关注资金是否从拥挤的AI股转向金融、材料等滞后行业。
美股.en:
The US equity market ended the week on a sour note as geopolitical risk from the Iran conflict overwhelmed any positive momentum. The S&P 500 dropped to 7,482.71, and Berkshire Hathaway continued to underperform the broader market. Meanwhile, the Fed released minutes from its June FOMC meeting and announced new monetary policy task forces, while housing and labour market data added to a mixed picture.

- [S&P 500 slips to 7,482.71 as Trump declares US-Iran ceasefire 'over'](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxON3V5WW5BbHQ4MXRFcDNpWlZoa0VTTHpSN3dkVG5tVm1SdURWMHhqWDh0R25SUUtfUS1raVdxMGttSG9KLVJBR3FBYzA3Y0tOamsybzM3eTJoV3lCUXlVNVk4LUpyTHMwRkxFRGI4OXJlUWdVUFk5RUZrT1FFdVlxNUR4MlMyc0wwUF9SM1V5NlNmQ3ZkNGNSWXR4ejI2R1diQ2tFQ01TY0xGUUEyamNnaUgwRlpLaWVvOFJrQ2o1dHo) — The benchmark's drop reflects a flight from risk assets as investors price in higher oil prices and uncertainty.
- [Berkshire Hathaway gains ground, but still trails the S&P 500 as '26 enters second half](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/berkshire-hathaway-gains-ground-but-still-trails-the-sp-500-as-26-enters-second-half.html) — Berkshire's B shares are down 1.8% YTD versus the S&P 500's 10.7% gain, highlighting the challenge for value-oriented conglomerates in a tech-driven market.
- [Federal Reserve announces leadership and objectives of its task forces to advance the conduct of monetary policy](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm) — The Fed is formalising internal reviews to improve forecasting and policy execution, a signal of introspection after recent inflation missteps.
- [Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260708a.htm) — The minutes likely show a divided committee on the pace of rate cuts amid sticky inflation, but the full text was released after the close.
- [New housing law targets affordability — what it means for homebuyers and sellers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/21st-century-road-to-housing-act-homebuyers-sellers.html) — The '21st Century Road to Housing Act' aims to alleviate supply constraints, but experts caution that benefits will take years to materialise.

The market is likely to remain volatile as the Iran situation develops, with energy and defence stocks outperforming while growth and tech names face headwinds from rising risk premiums.

中国经济.zh:
**内需分化：科技热VS汽车冷，外资加速设局**
中国A股航天板块因火箭回收技术突破而大涨，同时科技股吸引大量老年散户“泡沫式”追涨。然而传统制造领域寒意明显：大众汽车在华销量暴跌26%至16年最低，欧洲车商集体沦陷。房地产REITs的商业物业版图正式开启，开发商蜂拥上市，但市场信心仍需观察。

- [中国老年散户大举买入科技股，称“泡沫是啤酒最好喝的部分”](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360225/tech-stocks-capture-chinas-elderly-retail-investors-amid-faith-nations-tech-sector)
- [大众中国上半年交付量跌破100万辆，电动车竞争加速替代](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360214/volkswagen-china-deliveries-see-26-drop-year-year-lowest-point-2010)
- [中国开发商排队申报商业地产REITs，首批四单已获受理](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3360156/chinas-developers-eagerly-line-offer-commercial-property-reits-amid-recovery-signs)
- [京东斥资9600万美元收购香港酒店，进军学生宿舍市场](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQVk9yUHRMLVpkazFwdW9jQWd2NlM0d0FOb2JkTWptbkNCMlFEX1MxT3lYMk5kMUNIdWNvVVVYb2NQYkRYZ3RJNHZUQ1BSeWt0T05MTk42SUVTUUV6S0NmVHJZN0NEUVBMNDNxNFhLa21ZV2hZaFBUWlNFR2VxSV9uOWhleXdRUXlVWE02dTVWVDl2VXZvdE1IY0lUWmRzYU83N0tEQlhmRjV4RXc)

**判断**：中国科技股短期情绪高涨但估值透支风险加剧，而汽车产业链的深度调整尚未触底；REITs和香港资产布局显示资本正寻找避风港。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets showed mixed signals: tech stocks attracted a wave of elderly retail investors, while Volkswagen's China sales hit a 16-year low. Real estate REITs are gaining traction as developers line up offerings, and Hong Kong is advancing a gold-yuan network to reduce dollar dependency. However, German carmakers continue to face intense competition from local EV brands.

- [Tech stocks capture China’s elderly retail investors amid faith in nation’s tech sector](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360225/tech-stocks-capture-chinas-elderly-retail-investors-amid-faith-nations-tech-sector) — 'Foam is the best bit of a beer,' said a 77-year-old investor, underscoring speculative enthusiasm for chip and AI stocks despite high valuations.
- [Volkswagen China deliveries see 26% drop year on year to lowest point since 2010](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360214/volkswagen-china-deliveries-see-26-drop-year-year-lowest-point-2010) — Only 971,000 units delivered in H1 2026, as local EV makers like BYD and Nio capture market share.
- [China’s developers eagerly line up to offer commercial-property Reits amid recovery signs](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3360156/chinas-developers-eagerly-line-offer-commercial-property-reits-amid-recovery-signs) — 19 REIT applications are now in the pipeline, buoyed by hopes for a turnaround in the property sector.
- [Hong Kong builds a gold and yuan network that sidesteps dollar stablecoins](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQZms0NkxaM1diN2xQcTYwbENyZ0dUWVZkcnZsdEN2bm5jU2ZvZE5hbi1MMDRvLWJETEhoY2tqZ29QUEZtd290aVRTcUNSUHFJLUhVTThmTGMxemg3b29EX3plVG51X2pKVFpFcWJJX283OTFRRnd3WlRHSFJ1LWp5cldpdzRPZWxrLTdCc0FCaUZQcElIbzg5VGVuQjI5OXBtYnZzcEJlR3JxUGRmYUgxTDNn) — A strategic move to facilitate trade and investment without relying on US dollar stablecoins, signalling de-dollarisation efforts.
- [BYD showcases battery, charging technology in 15,000km journey from Rome to Hong Kong](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3360140/byd-showcases-battery-charging-technology-15000km-journey-rome-hong-kong) — BYD is using the road trip to promote its ultra-fast charging and long-range capabilities, reinforcing its global EV leadership.

Watch for further tech stock froth as retail money flows in, but also for regulatory tightening if speculation becomes excessive. The auto sector's pain for foreign players is a long-term trend; Chinese EV makers are consolidating their home advantage.

欧洲经济.zh:
**地缘冲击叠加AI通胀，欧央行陷入两难**
CAC 40随美伊冲突下跌至8,252.66点，欧元区物价在停火破裂后出现回升，欧洲央行面临新的通胀压力。高盛警告AI投资热潮可能率先在美国引发通胀，但欧洲也无法幸免。与此同时，欧洲领导人就提升竞争力达成共识，但具体措施尚待落地。

- [CAC 40跌至8,252.66，美伊动乱拖累欧洲市场](https://news.google.)
- [欧洲央行称通胀风险再起，因伊朗局势推高能源价格](https://news.google.)
- [高盛：美国将承受AI通胀的主要冲击，但溢出效应不可避免](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPWHYzaTRVOTFBWWo0RlQ1UFpTc3J0VU9Jcy1CRVN3ekYxZ0lTU1VvMW1SeGhrdkp4dEJFZGNlX3dCSGN6NmxtNjJhT0NhSTVZZDBWb3BwMzBjdzNuYWQtQVZ0N2J0c0hyMURwRzlEeVdtM1gyVHVVN0lxSmZKZ2RoM3JUNmVvdWdnM1czcUpaQ092NjQtT2FMQXNTMERNODAzUDNIOFh3SkoxRGM)
- [欧洲领导人就提升竞争力达成初步共识](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxPRlU3cjZDV1c5M2ZlZTZLeVRhTWhzSTQ2UlBUOUlfVVhVd2NtV2NnTk55R1F1emZlQkI5cmc3S3B1LUI1ajBhVFU3Wk5yV1p2dV96NVRUZk01MGpmZXcwWm1sUXB6bkRCMWVvTG40RDUyNzkxVkd0dWJ4WHdYNUNxQWJmdDl6ZnZzbWl5TE0zbWFKMExGUkV2LXdhbnF1ZDBLOXZwbEVpV2tteE9K)

**判断**：欧洲央行6月会议纪要显示内部对降息路径存在分歧，如今外部冲击将使决策更加谨慎，欧元区经济前景不确定性上升。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets were rattled by the US-Iran escalation, with the CAC 40 falling to 8,252.66. The ECB faces renewed inflation risk from higher energy prices, while a Goldman Sachs report warns that the US will suffer the most from AI-driven inflation. Meanwhile, European leaders are discussing ways to enhance competitiveness, and Chinese investment in European ports continues to draw scrutiny.

- [CAC 40 slides to 8,252.66 as renewed US-Iran hostilities rattle European markets](https://news.google.) — The Paris benchmark fell nearly 1.5% as energy supply fears resurfaced, with the eurozone's price growth already ticking up.
- [ECB faces renewed inflation risk as US-Iran tensions flare](https://news.google.) — Higher oil and gas prices could delay the ECB's rate-cutting cycle, complicating the outlook for growth.
- [Goldman Sachs warns the US will bear the brunt of a global AI-induced inflation surge](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPWHYzaTRVOTFBWWo0RlQ1UFpTc3J0VU9Jcy1CRVN3ekYxZ0lTU1VvMW1SeGhrdkp4dEJFZGNlX3dCSGN6NmxtNjJhT0NhSTVZZDBWb3BwMzBjdzNuYWQtQVZ0N2J0c0hyMURwRzlEeVdtM1gyVHVVN0lxSmZKZ2RoM3JUNmVvdWdnM1czcUpaQ092NjQtT2FMQXNTMERNODAzUDNIOFh3SkoxRGM) — The note argues that AI infrastructure investment is most intense in the US, making it the epicentre of potential price pressures.
- [Meeting of 10-11 June 2026](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/accounts/2026/html/ecb.mg260709~0e7f8241c9.en.html) — The ECB's governing council minutes, released on July 9, likely reflect concerns about underlying inflation persistence.
- [European leaders find common ground on ways to sharpen the region’s competitive edge](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxPRlU3cjZDV1c5M2ZlZTZLeVRhTWhzSTQ2UlBUOUlfVVhVd2NtV2NnTk55R1F1emZlQkI5cmc3S3B1LUI1ajBhVFU3Wk5yV1p2dV96NVRUZk01MGpmZXcwWm1sUXB6bkRCMWVvTG40RDUyNzkxVkd0dWJ4WHdYNUNxQWJmdDl6ZnZzbWl5TE0zbWFKMExGUkV2LXdhbnF1ZDBLOXZwbEVpV2tteE9K) — Discussions focused on reducing energy dependence and boosting digital innovation, but concrete measures remain vague.

The ECB is now caught between inflation risks and growth slowdown fears; the next policy decision will be heavily influenced by oil price dynamics. Watch for Chinese investment moves into European ports as a geopolitical flashpoint.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
**散户情绪分化：炒摘帽、追锂电、叹婚变**
社区热点集中在个股异动和行业数据：002980获127家机构调研，引发讨论；002005即将摘帽并停牌，投机资金跃跃欲试。同时，一家行业巨头董事长婚变导致近50亿资产分割，股价跌停，成为当日八卦焦点。原材料方面，氢氧化锂价格环比大涨，锂电产业链热度再起。

- [002980（华峰测控？）获127家机构调研](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5SV0JQRHlnWG96aThLU0FpcEpZYXBoMC1lZHRaaml6YnhfREpjWVhJOUxTUGpzMl9uU0huRzA0STVDcHJvZTN2alRTZ29haDhYUF9qTTU0V2dOdTJHbDlwUE93)

- [行业巨头董事长夫妇婚变，近50亿资产切割，股价跌停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9ZeDZyczh0NXlVNzdlYkxZT3M5Z2ctbzRTMkJWZEY4NXBNNEdXTWRydUZETTJVc1U0SElCLWsxOVhZak5pNXJwSUx6ZVhHc3JKcGtUZTNSai1SUmhJaVBHQ3Jn)

同花顺社区动态.en:
The 同花顺 community was active with specific stock news and broader market sentiment. Key stories included institutional visits to stock 002980, a company about to remove special treatment (摘帽), and an industry tycoon's divorce triggering a limit-down. Lithium hydroxide prices rose sharply, and WTI crude oil futures showed volatility amid the Iran crisis. Stock discussions on Meta Platforms also gained traction.

- [002980，127家机构调研](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5SV0JQRHlnWG96aThLU0FpcEpZYXBoMC1lZHRaaml6YnhfREpjWVhJOUxTUGpzMl9uU0huRzA0STVDcHJvZTN2alRTZ29haDhYUF9qTTU0V2dOdTJHbDlwUE93) — 127 institutions visited this A-share firm, signalling strong interest; the stock may see upward momentum next week.
- [002005，将摘帽！周一停牌！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE96Z1o3Zm5TSXlHZlpMcmgwZVFocmUzcHZWRXBwSDg1TWpUdjk2dExuLWgzd0xiNzVCMGFJSFZNUVFkQjlWbmxmNTczb0ZMY3VCV3ZWbDF6dFFTZW13R09hN2ZB) — Stock 002005 will have its special treatment removed and will be suspended Monday, a positive catalyst for holders.
- [行业巨头董事长夫妇，被曝婚变！近50亿资产要分割，股价应声跌停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9ZeDZyczh0NXlVNzdlYkxZT3M5Z2ctbzRTMkJWZEY4NXBNNEdXTWRydUZETTJVc1U0SElCLWsxOVhZak5pNXJwSUx6ZVhHc3JKcGtUZTNSai1SUmhJaVBHQ3Jn) — A major industry leader's divorce filing puts nearly 5 billion yuan in assets at stake; the stock hit the daily limit down, reflecting corporate governance risks.
- [价格前线|7月10日WTI原油—ICE期货收盘价(连续)异动提示](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9oWjlka3NRc2ZzU3lGS2NtQlRDVGJtaFUyUmZlS25HWFY5REJhYnFndl9PZVRZNjctdHg4UkxVR0tNYmctVkwwdkFfWWUtMmhUTjRpX253ZzMtYjd3cFE) — WTI crude showed significant movement on July 10, likely reflecting the Iran escalation. Community sentiment appears bullish on select stocks (002980, 002005) but cautious on governance issues (divorce case). The oil price move will keep energy and petrochemical stocks in focus. Watch for further institutional visits and earnings season catalysts.

欧美.zh:
中东火药桶复燃，北美枪声与欧洲大火齐鸣。美国对伊朗发动新打击后，伊朗革命卫队宣布关闭霍尔木兹海峡，并攻击约旦及海湾国家，局势急剧升级。与此同时，多伦多街头节日发生枪击，两人交火殃及无辜，凸显公共场所安保困境。西班牙野火已夺12命，成该国最致命火灾之一。政治层面，波兰总理公开提议为二战乌克兰民族主义者屠杀波兰人立碑，引发波乌外交敏感；特朗普政府则向《纽约时报》记者发出传票，涉及卡塔尔赠送空军一号的安全报道，新闻自由再受考验。

- [伊朗攻击约旦及海湾国家，霍尔木兹海峡关闭](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/12/iran-war-live-irgc-declares-strait-of-hormuz-closed-over-us-interference?traffic_source=rss)
- [多伦多节日枪击：2死4伤，警方定性为交火事件](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/12/toronto-shooting-two-dead-and-three-injured-as-police-search-for-active-shooter)
- [西班牙野火致12人死亡，含4名英国人](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- [波兰总理倡议为二战乌克兰民族主义者屠杀波兰人建纪念碑](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cze94x4361po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- [特朗普政府传唤《纽约时报》记者，涉及空军一号安全报道](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpd3g8q51g7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)

从冲突到言论自由，欧美社会正同时面临外部战争风险和内部治理挑战，短期内动荡将持续发酵。
欧美.en:
The Euro-American desk is defined by a major military escalation between the US and Iran, alongside domestic violence in Canada and Spain, and several political controversies. The Iran conflict has direct consequences for energy markets and regional allies; the Toronto shooting raises questions about public safety at large events; and the Polish-UKraine memorial issue adds a layer of historical grievance to wartime alliances.

- **Iran war escalates after US strikes**: US bombed Iranian cities; Iran closed Strait of Hormuz and attacked Jordan and Gulf states. Oil futures likely to spike. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj9gkpp0dkeo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/12/iran-war-live-irgc-declares-strait-of-hormuz-closed-over-us-interference?traffic_source=rss))
- **Toronto festival shooting kills two**: Police say targeted exchange between two individuals; Mayor decries 'irresponsible act of violence'. Community trauma and festival security scrutiny. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce3e66e1x3go), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/12/toronto-shooting-two-dead-and-three-injured-as-police-search-for-active-shooter))
- **Poland's PM seeks memorial for Volhynia massacre**: The pledge reopens a painful chapter in Polish-Ukrainian relations, complicating the current alliance against Russia. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cze94x4361po))
- **India's Muslim judge receives death threats**: Tabassum Khan's sentencing of Hindu cow vigilantes triggers online abuse; illustrates deep religious polarization in India. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd6e9zq87xvo))
- **Trump administration subpoenas NYT journalists**: Legal summons over reporting on security issues with Qatari-gifted Air Force One; potential press freedom battle. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpd3g8q51g7o))
- **Spain wildfire kills at least 12, including four Britons**: Over 23 missing; one of the deadliest fires in Spain's history, linked to extreme heat and drought. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo))

**Signal**: The Iran crisis is the clear center of gravity; readers should monitor oil market reactions and any further US or allied military moves.

日韩.zh:
东亚区域在科技突破与自然考验中前进。日本成功发射并回收一枚可重复使用火箭，标志着继美国之后又一步入该领域的国家，对降低卫星发射成本意义重大。然而，台风“巴威”先袭日本南部岛屿，再登陆中国浙江，日方提前疏散应对。经济层面，SK hynix以265亿美元创下外国公司在纳斯达克IPO记录，但三星创纪录利润未让市场兴奋，反映半导体行业竞争白热化。外交方面，14国支持南海仲裁裁决，但韩国未加入，引发关注；日本则面临中国游客未如期回归的旅游缺口。

- [日本成功发射并回收可重复使用火箭](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQZjE3QW9TMGZSSU8wWkZOZXRzRzE3X3FZUm51Qk8xUFk1MXNvckt5MXdoaFF2dFFUdFdKbEMxRl9NWDU3cXlsSHduVjgyOE9Kc0h2WEppdHpCVWJja1pucDF0cGI3VUZWQnFpUUZfbzh5OHdsT1B1X3hLZVA2bkpsa1V2czhITnFXdVJPbHotYXBNRkNuZ0hDaldxemN2TkFkb2JxMFhn)
