- [SK hynix以265亿美元创外国公司纳斯达克IPO纪录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9BbTRTbjZIYmdDai12RG5LT1dwaWxfVkpmU2hQMEF2N191MmtWQWlaWjItWHMyR2l4MHp3YWRZRTh2dDhSb29UR29HZHBVaXRHdG5STm1XNA)
- [14国支持南海裁决但韩国未加入](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPQzFSNHI4NnBVeGpZdlBjUnRLS1E4Yk14RXhkYWd1V2hGWmt2cmUzb0JRdUxJdVdENkh2cGxVLWkxdTdLbF9uQl81Q0NhbG5vNjY3TUFxYTdxRkZmU1hkMjZ3TTE3Q3c1SmFvSnFRbTctUWIyM21kUG1TVFdWTE8xMXlTLTM)

日本航天突破与台风防灾并行，韩国则面临半导体市场情绪分化和外交站位选择——日韩正处在科技自信与现实制约的十字路口。
日韩.en:
The Japan-Korea desk is shaped by the twin impacts of Typhoon Bavi, which lashed southern Japan and forced evacuations in China, and a series of geopolitical and economic stories touching on tourism, defense, and corporate finance. The typhoon’s agricultural and infrastructure damage will be significant; meanwhile, Japan’s struggle to attract Chinese tourists and South Korea’s absence from the South China Sea ruling highlight regional diplomatic currents.

- **Typhoon Bavi hits Japan’s southern islands**: Widespread damage reported; China evacuated 600,000 ahead of the storm. Recovery efforts underway. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQRXRvY3dvSWFhN0ctWDN4dmo3WGZKTVB2YkREdVVtUkZ4ckt0bklDQm5vcGp1clNQWGcycy02eGFQaGRSYTNEbktYQWp2MGZKNlptdDNfdmxkTFAzZ1VHWThSY1Zvd3Q0Z1lhY1ljdmNPc3pRdVFPVnhrbEt3enNGWUVRREM))
- **Japan wants 60 million tourists, but China isn’t sending them**: Chinese tourist numbers remain far below pre-pandemic levels, threatening Japan’s tourism recovery targets. ([SCMP](https://news.google.))
- **14 nations back South China Sea ruling—but not South Korea**: The absence of Seoul from the endorsement signals its delicate balancing act between the US and China. ([Chosun Ilbo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPQzFSNHI4NnBVeGpZdlBjUnRLS1E4Yk14RXhkYWd1V2hGWmt2cmUzb0JRdUxJdVdENkh2cGxVLWkxdTdLbF9uQl81Q0NhbG5vNjY3TUFxYTdxRkZmU1hkMjZ3TTE3Q3c1SmFvSnFRbTctUWIyM21kUG1TVFdWTE8xMXlTLTM))
- **SK hynix sets foreign IPO record with $26.5b Nasdaq offering**: The massive listing underscores Korea’s semiconductor prowess but also exposes the company to US regulatory and market risks. ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9BbTRTbjZIYmdDai12RG5LT1dwaWxfVkpmU2hQMEF2N191MmtWQWlaWjItWHMyR2l4MHp3YWRZRTh2dDhSb29UR29HZHBVaXRHdG5STm1XNA))
- **The Trump effect on Japan-South Korea relations**: Analysis of how Trump’s policies could reshape alliance dynamics, including trade and defense cost-sharing. ([East Asia Forum](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxNUmJFRkdYeWcydWR6ZjNCRVVzYW5fMXJRWi1odWV3ZjV4MVpWSklNQ1U0b3NPajFBbjYzU1lBV3pBZEEzSWtLMXVrcWNGcjYyeXNFYXZZdDJwNFBFcWhqaERtRG10c1Voa1VMV3hxelVxY0ktZklOLS1Sb3MtczdtZ05PVWtiYzlpTkZpcS13))

**Signal**: Watch for post-typhoon supply chain disruptions in semiconductors and agricultural products from Japan and South Korea, and any new trade measures from the Trump administration affecting Korean chipmakers.

中国.zh:
国内社会新闻以积极应对灾害和科技民生为主。台风“巴威”一周内第二次登陆中国东部，浙江紧急转移近200万人，温州直面风暴。官方报道强调无人机“破例”吊人彰显民生温度，展现应急创新。科技领域，研究报告称中国电力技术创新能力位居全球首位；全国150余所院校学者聚广州探讨AI时代高校评价范式转型。外交方面，中国社会组织在联合国人权理事会发声，医疗队分赴基里巴斯、巴布亚新几内亚开展义诊。此外，北京农商银行与民生银行签署战略合作协议，金融层面亦有关注。

- [台风“巴威”登陆浙江，近200万人撤离](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxd3wkp2rzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- [无人机“破例”吊人彰显民生温度](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNazU5MW94dU55MURYVEE5VWQxQ3ZBVzQyMnBld2lEeVJ4X293eHQ5SlN6X3JkdzM2dGwzdk9Ib01JUlBzNHlvMmkzbVpyY1JZbmZJaVdzNUpkUXU4eDVMM0JUR0lGcFlYNnlOZldqTFg4M2x4WjI4QjhXMElnVmdoZQ)
- [研究报告：中国电力技术全球第一](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5FeHA5bjA0eG1PaHl2eVNzQWNBR2RGRjlVOEc1T1llbVBXNXhocTJhRkZtRWpLRG1ybmVnTV9wY1pPODRuZXhib08wSlJaZnpybUxZWWxCXzZhTXNQUmlNYzJTLWZVUmtKb0doRE9QeF8yTk1vUW1QdzFoZlRaQQ)
- [全国150余所院校学者探讨AI时代高校评价转型](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9HRWw2bC1VZC1fMUxHOFl3ZUpJNHk2WWtIWWY2T19ueDR5Rl9zWnREVjBTSWpvN1ZQZFB4WjMtVU1wNzA4MVlhOUc4b09Yenk2T21qTWsxaDhPU1hHMkxhTmlFcWlmWlV4XzBlaQ)
- [中国社会组织在联合国人权理事会传递中国声音](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9QejhmdFppUTEyMXZ3MktPaUVwbm5NY1djeUY4YlZpQVVvRHJQRFlPSlFjN1hOWkxiUm1rUkFvTE56TU1JS1JNaGkxX0RSSlpnbExmbEhyV3BCZXN4dzFYc25rQzJob0RVcHczcTU3NkdVUjBZNUI2TlhRNHhVX0E)

中国在应对极端天气、推动科技创新和国际发声方面保持节奏，但台风后续次生灾害及AI伦理讨论值得持续跟进。
中国.en:
China's domestic news is a mix of educational symposia, medical diplomacy, and technological achievements, with little breaking drama but several notable developments. The typhoon coverage is dominated by evacuation numbers, while official media highlights China's global role in power technology innovation and medical missions. The tone is largely positive and institutional.

- **Typhoon Bavi forces evacuations of 2 million in Zhejiang**: The second typhoon in a week demonstrates China's disaster preparedness capacity. Wenzhou area affected. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxd3wkp2rzo))
- **China's power technology innovation ranks first globally**: A new report from Xinhua claims China leads the world in power tech, reinforcing the narrative of technological self-reliance. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5FeHA5bjA0eG1PaHl2eVNzQWNBR2RGRjlVOEc1T1llbVBXNXhocTJhRkZtRWpLRG1ybmVnTV9wY1pPODRuZXhib08wSlJaZnpybUxZWWxCXzZhTXNQUmlNYzJTLWZVUmtKb0doRE9QeF8yTk1vUW1QdzFoZlRaQQ))
- **Chinese medical teams conduct overseas missions**: The 5th team to Kiribati and 15th team to Papua New Guinea are providing free clinics, part of China's 'health diplomacy' push. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5tT25pUll3dHBrbWg4T2V4R3NLSHpqMTh0dDdtbkZ2MVlISWpSVjRzd25STUJ4amVnRXRmOWxpcGttNnEyTGJfTUZYeklfX2NVTjd1dWxYUFF5dktKTnlzeHJETGh3YnZiQnFvdnhYZDQtTzl4LTc4cURSX2ltTjQ), [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9XekZkVHBwakRUdVVSWTIxckFfQTN2OUlPT1ltWmtjaTJvdUNDcHhQZVd6aUUwczF6YWtzM2J2dlRZS0ZuWDJaeFFDTUFUYklqZVJCZ1Nyc1VtS2JtTEZ5aDZBc1RiUG1Wb1NFRUk0d1NxdTJRVW04))
- **AI and education forum held at Guangzhou City University of Technology**: 370+ scholars discussed evaluating higher education in the AI era, reflecting China's push to integrate AI into pedagogy. ([Education Online](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9HRWw2bC1VZC1fMUxHOFl3ZUpJNHk2WWtIWWY2T19ueDR5Rl9zWnREVjBTSWpvN1ZQZFB4WjMtVU1wNzA4MVlhOUc4b09Yenk2T21qTWsxaDhPU1hHMkxhTmlFcWlmWlV4XzBlaQ))
- **Drone rescue demonstrates 'people-first' governance**: A drone was used to lift a person in an emergency, highlighted by China Daily as an example of technology serving the people. ([China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNazU5MW94dU55MURYVEE5VWQxQ3ZBVzQyMnBld2lEeVJ4X293eHQ5SlN6X3JkdzM2dGwzdk9Ib01JUlBzNHlvMmkzbVpyY1JZbmZJaVdzNUpkUXU4eDVMM0JUR0lGcFlYNnlOZldqTFg4M2x4WjI4QjhXMElnVmdoZQ))

**Signal**: China's focus remains on internal stability, technological advancement, and soft power projection; typhoon recovery will be the near-term operational priority.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区本周话题偏娱乐与商业。演员王玉雯一句“岁月光‘阴’你了”因东北口音直爽风格走红，被用户视为“治好了精神内耗”，反映社区对真实、反套路表达的追捧。电影《亨利与琼》的讨论则偏向文艺怀旧。商业层面，知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源表示将加速AI商业化探索，显示平台在用户增长放缓后寻求技术变现。此外，社区内出现大量仿冒品广告（如“Gucci高仿知乎”），暴露平台内容治理顽疾。

- [王玉雯“岁月光阴你了”引爆全网，东北直爽治愈精神内耗](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5VYm15SnJxd0ZEc0d4V1ljRlotTE5rUmhEcFVHRzI2dDZwNlZzX2JrZTE4YlNGVXpBcHVJNXVwY2ZvMEFtMmFPR09IYi1Lc1U)
- [知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO称加速AI商业化](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)
- [垃圾广告“Gucci高仿知乎”仍在传播，内容治理任重道远](https://news.google.)

知乎面临营收下滑与内容生态双重压力，AI商业化能否破局仍是未知数，而用户对轻松、真实内容的渴求或成为社区转型的线索。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu community dynamics this cycle are relatively quiet, with no major viral debates or scandals. The standout story is the CEO's announcement of a 23.6% revenue decline and a pivot to AI monetization, signaling financial pressure at the platform. A celebrity quip and a film review generate mild engagement, while spam posts about counterfeit goods indicate ongoing moderation challenges.

- **Zhihu 2025 revenue down 23.6%, CEO pushes AI monetization**: The platform is accelerating AI-related commercial exploration to reverse losses. Investors and users should watch for product changes. ([Cailianshe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))
- **Wang Yuwen's viral quote '岁月光‘阴’你了' sparks discussion**: The actress's candid remark resonates with netizens as a moment of 'straightforwardness curing emotional exhaustion.' ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5VYm15SnJxd0ZEc0d4V1ljRlotTE5rUmhEcFVHRzI2dDZwNlZzX2JrZTE4YlNGVXpBcHVJNXVwY2ZvMEFtMmFPR09IYi1Lc1U))
- **Spam posts about counterfeit Gucci and fake Zhihu accounts**: Coordinated spam linking to X posts indicates persistent bot-driven marketing activity, eroding user trust. ([x.com](https://news.google.))
- **Film review 'Henry and June'**: A post discussing the 1990 film draws a small audience of cinephiles, but with limited engagement. ([Wenxuecity](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTFBRblZUeTRENDNhNk13RUtsb3RMb2lNSkUzOTM5QVhRcmNsTGUwb1gyOGx5V2Q1dmpuaXdEaURZQjVJelZiYUZqRHoyV2ZFYVBNUWJJYWVaVk1PaF9sdER5UUszTjE))

**Signal**: The revenue decline and AI pivot are the most consequential stories for Zhihu's business health; user sentiment data from upcoming earnings calls will be critical.

冲突局势.zh:
中东与东欧两条战线同步升温。伊朗导弹精确命中约旦美军基地，特朗普承认考虑有限打击，霍尔木兹海峡通行量虽环比回升但仍远低于战前水平。乌克兰宣称一夜摧毁21艘俄油轮，俄方暂停顿河-亚速海航运，粮食贸易受创。胡塞武装控制区出现大规模集会支持伊朗并警告沙特，也门局势与伊朗冲突联动效应显现。

- **[伊朗弹道导弹命中约旦美军基地](https://news.google.)**：卫星图像证实打击精度，新建机库遭毁，美军在中东的防空反导能力受质疑。
- **[乌克兰打击俄油轮与俄方停航](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPX0RKalN2ZXdjSjlpckFybFhMclVwU0h4R2FUd1loU0lDN1hXak1SR1VydUFnaTFkMVI5aWRib184d3ZkWmxpamliZ3UydDU0OVpjdUpSVENRcmxUUmF5TDRrQmVXOGJ3aU9UWUFidEtWUXFnSnJzODZZZk0yWHBlUkk2T0h5SHNxbGFMdm9sajBEOHkwa0pwOA)**：俄方暂停亚速海航运，可能加剧全球粮食供应紧张。
- **[胡塞武装大规模集会支持伊朗](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQZEctb2JTTVdUOTFTdjJJd2lfOTVzeFk2X1pfMUlZWUs5NUlQNk1rYjVQVHlmR3M2NjJHNTU2T2pqN2xzV1VSUnRGSU9Ua1E1ZVhlVVVUb0hENno2TFg4OEVDR3BXS0dqTjJBQlFralJ2R0xjNmEzLVdqQ0FLRmhXNF84THl0aWhFc3lwODF0bUVETVV5cXlIQkE4Y2Q1Rk5NYXpXZzVKTHB5Ti1WaWYxdFphclduUVZFRFFIRA)**：也门冲突与伊朗危机合流，沙特面临南北夹击风险。
- **[霍尔木兹海峡通行量回升但仍远低常态](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)**：6月通行量从5月233艘增至576艘，但同比去年6月3131艘仍下降81%，航运恢复脆弱。

**收束**：伊朗已从海上骚扰升级为直接打击美军基地，乌克兰则瞄准俄能源航运，两条战线均指向对方经济与军事基础设施。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict landscape is defined by two major axes: Iran's confrontation with the US and its allies in the Gulf, and Ukraine's bid to interdict Russian sea lines of communication in the Sea of Azov. NATO's Ankara summit seeks to adapt to multipolar pressures, while Houthi rallies in Yemen signal continued solidarity with Iran. A diplomatic track between Lebanon and Israel is also active, with Rome talks confirmed.

- **NATO at a crossroads:** The [Hormuz crisis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5uc3l1X242Q1Ribk0temVhMDhGRHMzRzJNa3NCb1pqaldyTmlqWE1GRzhMYXktdVdDbW40d19uMS1VcTcwcWotNVg1R1F5eGFJSFp6T2o4WHpUSEdxZ1M3amxzb2o) and the [Ankara Summit](https://news.google.) are forcing a strategic rethink, with questions about whether NATO can effectively project power in the Middle East and the Indo-Pacific simultaneously.

- **Ukraine targets Russia's Azov lifeline:** Kyiv claims [21 Russian tankers hit](https://news.google.); Russia retaliates by [halting Don-Azov shipping](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPX0RKalN2ZXdjSjlpckFybFhMclVwU0h4R2FUd1loU0lDN1hXak1SR1VydUFnaTFkMVI5aWRib184d3ZkWmxpamliZ3UydDU0OVpjdUpSVENRcmxUUmF5TDRrQmVXOGJ3aU9UWUFidEtWUXFnSnJzODZZZk0yWHBlUkk2T0h5SHNxbGFMdm9sajBEOHkwa0pwOA), impacting global grain trade. The prospect of [cutting Russia's land bridge](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE83SnJuWno0SGFhclBaRW5XNW0wX0dtbmNzRENjcmQxVmlDQjNVLUFQbzItVVAySzhpME0tWXU2VnVrQUROZnkxU29obVkwejg) is now more tangible.

- **Houthi rallies show regional solidarity:** Mass rallies in Houthi-held areas [back Iran and warn Saudi Arabia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQZEctb2JTTVdUOTFTdjJJd2lfOTVzeFk2X1pfMUlZWUs5NUlQNk1rYjVQVHlmR3M2NjJHNTU2T2pqN2xzV1VSUnRGSU9Ua1E1ZVhlVVVUb0hENno2TFg4OEVDR3BXS0dqTjJBQlFralJ2R0xjNmEzLVdqQ0FLRmhXNF84THl0aWhFc3lwODF0bUVETVV5cXlIQkE4Y2Q1Rk5NYXpXZzVKTHB5Ti1WaWYxdFphclduUVZFRFFIRA), deepening the Iran-led axis.

**Signal:** The convergence of Gaza-related diplomacy (Lebanon-Israel talks) and Iran confrontation suggests a wider regional realignment is being negotiated – watch for outcomes from Rome.

国际安全.zh:
美军在中东遭遇导弹突袭后，F-22被指几乎无用并已撤出中东。特朗普考虑有限打击，但美军同时在高能激光和反无人机领域加速投入。乌克兰获得美方许可后有望自建“爱国者”系统，并推动欧洲盟友研发更廉价的“芙蕾雅”反导系统。俄罗斯从北德文斯克重新部署防空系统，北极方向出现兵力抽空迹象。

- **[美军F-22几乎无用被撤出中东](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNWEd1R0xtVE5EQTU2a3ljOVdfODBYZDRSWVZUXzM2SWEwaHF1clZmUjdwdjRqZVYyM1pwYWdIWVNfdVQ3UmRXLVlDVkxOdll5SmVmNHJ0cENjckFRUFdoeDlZTWRMTFFKNFNPOHVvWFRfZzNoZ0NScTFqUmhvMVV1b09YbHg)**：隐身战机在伊朗防空体系面前效能受限，暴露美军高端装备在中等强度冲突中的短板。
- **[美空军推动500kW级激光武器应对巡航导弹](https://news.google.)**：目标直指伊朗、俄罗斯、中国的巡航导弹威胁，但技术成熟度仍存疑。
- **[乌克兰将获“爱国者”生产许可，但也需数年](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/ukraine-can-soon-build-its-own-patriots-but-it-could-take-years/)**：同时泽连斯基推动欧洲盟友联合开发“芙蕾雅”系统，寻求更廉价的反导替代方案。
- **[卫星图像显示俄从北德文斯克撤走防空系统](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxPWGp1LWtGN2pTclg4dnNnYTdEWVBHYkZOVXh2WjZHdHk3X3NiU0drQjJid3U3Y2hlcWtlaFo3QWFrRUFRYl9IUU43YnhjdEx2akUtaTFqMTNUbzhLNU5BRklqYlBVX09CTGJFX0FuU3FFSXRQQkZnd3huZnhBZ0ZtS3AwUVcwMDlpMDZNQzFGMVc2Y24yWmc2ZlFTci1BNUoyNThyV2g3RFdaYV9rM0FLa3R1c2Zlejd2REtTbE82Uzl0aXZX)**：可能为加强乌克兰前线或中东方向防空力量，北极防空出现缺口。
- **[澳大利亚完成SM-2导弹首次实战化拦截试验](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQVjlMbHlMdFVtOFNSbEVOVVpPWlRqamtNdGpFYzcxRHRtUW0zdlhtd01LNndXYmZodmM0N0Y5ZWFBSEczc3BqbUdWVE9VTXpJYUwwYzBsVklxMTBYaTQ5d2YtUHZKaXV2SXIxWEY2VlVvTmlJdFdzOFpZTUNSMzExZHY5WVBBbzl6MjdLVDdsaTNWY3N4aHVFcEsyWjM2YVU3M3NnZm9IN1JiaXZMWDE4UDBucWNWaTRYYkYxMjdJalVvWnZp)**：标志着印太地区防空反导能力重大升级。

**收束**：美军在应对伊朗时暴露隐身飞机不足，但正通过扩充弹药库存、发展新质防御能力弥补；乌克兰反导能力建设与欧洲合作可能重塑东欧防空格局。
国际安全.en:
The security landscape is marked by direct kinetic strikes, evolving missile defense strategies, and a major Pentagon AI policy shift. Iran's confirmed ballistic missile hit on the US air base in Jordan redefines the threat to American forces, while Ukraine pursues indigenous Patriot-like systems. The US is simultaneously withdrawing older stealth assets and pouring investment into next-generation defenses.

- **Iran strikes US base in Jordan:** Satellite images confirm [Iranian ballistic missiles hit US Muwaffaq Salti Air Base](https://news.google.) from over 1,000km away, showcasing precision strike capability. This raises serious questions about US base vulnerability.

- **US F-22s judged ineffective against Iran:** [Military Watch reports F-22s withdrawn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNWEd1R0xtVE5EQTU2a3ljOVdfODBYZDRSWVZUXzM2SWEwaHF1clZmUjdwdjRqZVYyM1pwYWdIWVNfdVQ3UmRXLVlDVkxOdll5SmVmNHJ0cENjckFRUFdoeDlZTWRMTFFKNFNPOHVvWFRfZzNoZ0NScTFqUmhvMVV1b09YbHg) after being 'nearly useless,' implying that legacy stealth platforms struggle against Iran's air defense network and that the US is rethinking its force posture.

- **Ukraine moves toward Patriot production:** Ukraine may soon [build its own Patriots under license](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/ukraine-can-soon-build-its-own-patriots-but-it-could-take-years/), while President Zelenskyy pushes for a cheaper alternative, 'Freya,' with European allies as reported by [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/zelenskyy-taps-european-allies-to-build-freya-a-cheaper-patriot-alternative-to-russias-ballistic-missiles/). This reflects a shift toward long-term defense industrial independence.

- **Pentagon orders purge of Anthropic AI:** The Air Force memo [demands contractors remove Anthropic by Sept. 1](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/air-force-pushing-contractors-to-purge-anthropic-by-sept-1-memo/), despite the company's lawsuit. This could disrupt AI integration across defense systems.

**Signal:** The increased tempo of precision strikes and the Pentagon's simultaneous AI purge suggest a modernization drive that prioritizes proven kinetic systems over emerging tech, at least in the short term.

中国军情.zh:
7月12日恰逢“南海仲裁案”裁决十周年，中国官媒密集刊文强调主权，并出现建议声索巴丹群岛主权的舆论试探。与此同时，中国科学家破译南海抹香鲸“方言”的新闻看似非军事，实则暗示中国在南海长期水下声学监测能力。美方将部分中国企业列入“中国军事企业清单”，CIA也被曝试图拉拢中国干部。朝鲜日报透露朝鲜特殊军事盟友访华，美韩对此不安。

- **[中国官媒刊登全版建议声索巴丹群岛主权](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1WYS1adkNRRmgyZHNadUF1WjVuSTRMd0tjRDFTbmcwNHh4djEzVXNiVk9Ucm1tRi1rbTlYV3lWV2VTZEJSOW5UYmFmbjlhT0dyOGcwWDZxMDVPcnkxVUYtNXVKS2hrZXBh)**：巴丹群岛位于台湾与菲律宾之间，声索意味着可能扩大对第一岛链的制衡。
- **[南海仲裁案十周年：中国强化对南海岛屿管辖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE02eV9YYkFzcm1YeFZ4SUk2Q3puR0R1aWVac21QRW4wMEdyelNWZHE3U21HNklFeDZTdDdFbElHUTVHT2xVVDVwMDZJbTZQVF9kSDdDazdJc1VjVV9KVWxjM3FTNUVjR0NZaWNaNkxuUE5nODFBWG00NVFxYWpLQTQ)**：多个官媒统一口径，指裁决非法无效，中国进一步巩固实际控制。
- **[中国科学家破译南海抹香鲸“方言”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQTEdHMmc0RU9zODFVT2ZHVU1DZy1kYlJOcXNFMnd2RktGLUN1ejlyU1R5dllDdlMyOHlaTXhCRlo3VG5MWjI3aFN3VThDOTVvUUVUUWRuek1zVGJYWjJabUVCT0s0QzBpQk15UlhCeWdyN3psLTVfbkpYT1lhNHoyeV9xSlRJVVZ5YXN6bw)**：深海所七年来八次南海远航采集声学数据，表明中国具备长期的海洋声学监测能力，此类数据可用于反潜作战环境感知。
- **[美将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)**：商务部回应反对，中美科技与军事脱钩加速。
- **[朝鲜日报称中国特殊军事盟友访华](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5ZWnEzanVSVUhMU3NmQWZKY0xHTVhUVWFUQS1WMXlvS0FfeEJXQWVWUG80NW1rejNBdWN1aEY4N2J4SEJJcmpPTi1xRHhIYjJFSW5LZlFqc0xETUZFOTRWamlB)**：指朝鲜高层访华，美韩担忧中朝军事合作加深。

**收束**：十周年之际，中国在南海采取法律与舆论攻势，并试探向北延伸主权声索；水下声学能力的曝光值得域内国家警惕，中美在南海的军事博弈正从海面延伸到水下。
中国军情.en:
China's military-diplomatic posture is hardening around the South China Sea on the 10th anniversary of the arbitration ruling, with state media launching coordinated sovereignty narratives. A surprise visit by a 'special military ally' (likely North Korea) to Beijing and a state-run call to claim the Batan Islands signal potential expansion of territorial ambitions. Meanwhile, reports of CIA attempts to recruit Chinese officials highlight ongoing espionage tensions.

- **South China Sea arbitration anniversary used to reinforce claims:** Multiple outlets ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE02eV9YYkFzcm1YeFZ4SUk2Q3puR0R1aWVac21QRW4wMEdyelNWZHE3U21HNklFeDZTdDdFbElHUTVHT2xVVDVwMDZJbTZQVF9kSDdDazdJc1VjVV9KVWxjM3FTNUVjR0NZaWNaNkxuUE5nODFBWG00NVFxYWpLQTQ), [China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE0tUjd1bk9yanNURkJ6TG1sd3pfV3Z3bWVJSnkxSnd6MVNlc293ZlBIeW1vaUpYM3hCaWRpbmVXWlVEVjN6THBXeFpzb2duVkZPYVFoaE5rX0MtR2hLN3cxTTgtdFlIbGJCckpnQ3BIS3pJTE1XY2ZDRjlYUms)) carry coordinated pieces denouncing the ruling as a 'farce' and asserting 'indisputable sovereignty.' This is a deliberate messaging push.

- **Call for sovereignty over Batan Islands:** [An official Chinese media outlet](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1WYS1adkNRRmgyZHNadUF1WjVuSTRMd0tjRDFTbmcwNHh4djEzVXNiVk9Ucm1tRi1rbTlYV3lWV2VTZEJSOW5UYmFmbjlhT0dyOGcwWDZxMDVPcnkxVUYtNXVKS2hrZXBh) published a full-page suggestion that Beijing claim the Batan Islands (north of Luzon), a dramatic escalation of rhetoric that could foreshadow actual maritime claims.

- **CIA targeting Chinese officials:** A [Chosun Ilbo report](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOR3kxcUdVMlViSkFYbFZsa2huR1c3UW5jMF8tSVdLS1BrSk9HMjU5NmYwNWktSkY0cmlJOUpEaE83MVpKZWFtZVR0RUJadzBhUk8yZkd3S0RhOGdvbTNQeGV2Q2w0N3dPenVYdWN6Nkx4aGVTMm03WUIwdUItX3JsQlpIbmRuYlF5d1lkZjFieHlmcXotSkIwUlVtWnVnMlFB) alleges the CIA is using 'counter-terrorism' pretexts to recruit Chinese cadres, highlighting the espionage dimension of US-China competition.

**Signal:** Beijing is using the arbitration anniversary to consolidate domestic and regional narratives – expect heightened naval patrols and possible incidents in the South China Sea in the coming weeks.

海军与印太.zh:
霍尔木兹海峡危机对全球航运的冲击开始显现，但6月通行量环比回升一倍多，航运业在战火中寻找通道。美军LRASM/JASSM产量将提高三倍，为对华威慑储备远程打击弹药。反无人机海战体系成为新关注点，澳美日在印太加强反导合作。RIMPAC 2026进入实弹阶段，加拿大、澳大利亚等舰艇参演。美国海军新规限制医疗剃须豁免期限，看似细节但反映战备从严。

- **[LRASM/JASSM产量将提高三倍](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/)**：未来5-7年采购超11000枚，重点覆盖印太战区远程反舰和对地攻击需求。
- **[霍尔木兹海峡6月通行量环比翻倍仍远低于去年](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)**：5月233艘→6月576艘，但同比去年6月3131艘下降81%，航运保险费用仍高企。
- **[反无人机海战：匹配传感器与效应器](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/anti-drone-warfare-at-sea-matching-sensors-and-effectors-to-the-threat/)**：文章强调AESA雷达、光电跟踪与硬杀伤链路，针对中低端无人机蜂群威胁。
- **[RIMPAC 2026进入实弹阶段](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-10-2026)**：加拿大皇家海军护卫舰率先开火，无人水面艇参演，体现多域无人作战趋势。
- **[太平洋岛国拒绝导弹试验](https://news.google.)**：南太岛国抵制大国军事化，可能影响美军在第二岛链的试验与部署计划。

**收束**：印太海上力量建设呈现“高端弹药储备+低端无人机防御”双轨并行，霍尔木兹危机经验正在被太平洋方向借鉴。
海军与印太.en:
The Indo-Pacific naval arena sees rapid force structure changes: the US Air Force is tripling production of key anti-ship and strike missiles, Australia successfully tested an SM-2 interceptor, and RIMPAC 2026 is underway with live-fire drills. However, the Strait of Hormuz traffic remains severely depressed even after a June recovery, reflecting the Iran war's chokehold on global shipping.

- **US missile production surge:** The Air Force plans to [buy over 11,000 JASSM and LRASM missiles](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/) in 5-7 years, a tripling of planned production. This signals a shift to a 'high-end' naval warfare posture focused on anti-access/area denial (A2/AD) defeat.

- **Australia's missile defense milestone:** [Australia's SM-2 shot down a cruise missile](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQVjlMbHlMdFVtOFNSbEVOVVpPWlRqamtNdGpFYzcxRHRtUW0zdlhtd01LNndXYmZodmM0N0Y5ZWFBSEczc3BqbUdWVE9VTXpJYUwwYzBsVklxMTBYaTQ5d2YtUHZKaXV2SXIxWEY2VlVvTmlJdFdzOFpZTUNSMzExZHY5WVBBbzl6MjdLVDdsaTNWY3N4aHVFcEsyWjM2YVU3M3NnZm9IN1JiaXZMWDE4UDBucWNWaTRYYkYxMjdJalVvWnZp) in a historic live-fire test, boosting Indo-Pacific air and missile defense. This comes as Lockheed Martin also advances Australia's [TADRS radar sustainment](https://news.google.) programme.

- **Hormuz traffic partially recovers:** [Transits through the Strait of Hormuz doubled to 576 in June](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks) from 233 in May, but remain 80% below pre-crisis levels (3,131 in June 2025). The shipping industry is testing the waters but risk remains extreme.

**Signal:** The Indo-Pacific is bracing for a missile-heavy conflict paradigm, while the Iran war proves that sea lines of communication can be severely disrupted even without full blockade – watch for further attacks on tankers in the Gulf.

科技产品.zh:
2-3 句概览：本周硬件新闻亮点与雷点齐飞。Nopia合成器历经三年跳票后终于「基本完工」，有望成为音乐制作人的新宠；而Philips Hue Bridge Pro的一次固件更新导致大量设备变砖，被迫紧急提供免费更换。此外，无摄像头智能眼镜开始瞄准会议场景，Ninja冰沙机成为纽约热浪中的救命稻草。

- [After years of teasing, the viral Nopia synth is ‘basically finished’](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/964499/nopia-viral-synth-finished-price-release-demo) — 2023年爆红的Nopia合成器终于接近上市，开发者带原型机到MusicRadar办公室展示，定价与发售日期尚未公布。
- [Philips offers free replacements after update bricked smart lighting hubs](https://www.engadget.com/2212954/philips-free-replacements-hue-bridge-pro-update-bricked-smart-lighting-hubs/) — Philips Hue Bridge Pro 遭遇致命更新，官方承诺免费更换并推送修复版固件，反应速度可圈可点。
- [Smart glasses without a camera? Even Realities bets productivity beats recording everyone](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/11/smart-glasses-without-a-camera-even-realities-bets-productivity-beats-recording-everyone/) — Even Realities 推出无摄像头智能眼镜，主打会议摘要与实时翻译，避开隐私雷区。
- [This slushie machine was a lifesaver during NYC’s heat wave](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/11/this-slushie-machine-was-a-lifesaver-during-nycs-heat-wave/) — Ninja Slushi Twist冰沙机在纽约热浪中成网红，评测称其完全取代便利店Slurpee。
- [Samsung Micro RGB R95H Review (2026): Not the Brightest](https://www.wired.com/review/samsung-micro-rgb-r95h/) — 三星新一代Micro RGB电视R95H被Wired评价未达预期亮度，与竞品对比黯然失色。

收束判断：智能家居与影音产品的「修复性创新」比「突破性创新」更抢眼——用户更关心固件稳定性而非参数堆砌。
科技产品.en:
The consumer tech desk had a busy day with a mix of product launches, hardware failures, and quirky gadgets. Philips is still cleaning up after a firmware update bricked its premium smart lighting hubs; the company now offers free replacements, but trust may be shaken. The long-awaited Nopia synth is finally nearing retail, while Ninja's new slushie machine earned praise for beating NYC's heat wave. In wearables, Even Realities unveiled camera-free smart glasses focused on productivity, and Beatbot's self-cleaning pool robot got a Wired review. On the quirky side, Nintendo's Talking Flower toy got a small price cut, and FL Studio's CEO made a Reddit AMA.

- **[Philips offers free replacements after update bricked smart lighting hubs](https://www.engadget.com/2212954/philips-free-replacements-hue-bridge-pro-update-bricked-smart-lighting-hubs/)** – A cautionary tale for anyone relying on smart home infrastructure. The new update should prevent recurrence, but the incident highlights the fragility of IoT ecosystems.
- **[After years of teasing, the viral Nopia synth is ‘basically finished’](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/964499/nopia-viral-synth-finished-price-release-demo)** – This instrument has been a legend in the music gear world. The Verge got a hands-on look; expect a launch price announcement soon.
- **[Smart glasses without a camera? Even Realities bets productivity beats recording everyone](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/11/smart-glasses-without-a-camera-even-realities-bets-productivity-beats-recording-everyone/)** – By omitting a camera, the glasses sidestep privacy concerns and target frequent travelers and meeting-goers. A smart positioning in a crowded market.
- **[Beatbot AquaSense X Review: A Pool Robot That Cleans Itself](https://www.wired.com/review/beatbot-aquasense-x/)** – Wired praises the self-cleaning feature but notes the significant price premium over Beatbot’s flagship. For pool owners who value automation, this could be a game-changer.
- **[Samsung Micro RGB R95H Review (2026): Not the Brightest](https://www.wired.com/review/samsung-micro-rgb-r95h/)** – Wired’s review of Samsung’s new micro LED TV is lukewarm, pointing to underwhelming brightness compared to rivals. Buyers should wait for competing models.

**Signal to watch**: Track the Nopia launch—if it ships on time, it could reignite the boutique synth market. Also, monitor Philips' replacement logistics: delays could escalate into a class-action risk.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
2-3 句概览：HackerNews 今日热议的两条线：一是 xAI 的 Grok Build CLI 被曝将用户信息发送至 xAI 服务器，引发隐私担忧；二是 Scheme 语言社区活跃，多个纯 Scheme Web 工具登上首页，显示函数式编程在简洁性上的号召力。此外，Long Covid 对胃神经的物理损害证据引起健康关注。

- [What xAI's Grok Build CLI Actually Sends to xAI](https://gist.github.com/cereblab/dc9a40bc26120f4540e4e09b75ffb547) — 一位开发者逆向分析发现Grok Build CLI在上传本地代码时夹带额外数据，引发对xAI透明度的质疑，讨论热度和质疑声均较高（129 points）。
- [A Erlang style pure Scheme Webserver and further](https://igropyr.com/) 与 [A pure scheme web programming tool](https://goeteia.dev/) — 两篇同日发布的纯Scheme Web服务方案，志在复现Erlang式并发，触发对「最小化框架」的讨论。
- [Long Covid May Physically Damage the Nerves That Control the Stomach](https://www.ijidonline.com/article/S1201-9712(26)00608-9/fulltext) — 新研究证实Long Covid可伤害胃部控制神经，为胃肠症状提供病理基础，79 points，用户关注度远超一般医学新闻。
- [Small Inventors Are Being Squeezed by a Convoluted Patent Process](https://www.nationalreview.com/news/small-inventors-are-being-squeezed-by-a-convoluted-patent-process/) — 专利系统复杂性挤压小发明家，呼应社区一贯的反专利垄断情绪。
- [Why Write Code in 2026](https://softwaredoug.com/blog/2026/07/09/write-code.html) — 一篇反思编程意义的文章，尽管讨论不多，但点出2026年AI写代码背景下人类编程的角色。

收束判断：HackerNews 社区在2026年依然保持对隐私、语言哲学与基础科学的敏锐嗅觉，Grok 的隐私问题可能加速开发者转向开源替代。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News front page today reflects a community deeply engaged with fundamental science, software craftsmanship, and systemic grievances. Top stories include a Quanta Magazine article revealing that simple fluids can fracture—a counterintuitive physics finding. Software engineers are debating the value of writing code in an AI-heavy era, and a deep dive into what xAI's Grok Build CLI actually sends to the mothership has sparked privacy concerns (129 points, 69 comments). Meanwhile, a post about long COVID damaging stomach nerves has strong medical interest, and the death of Martha Lillard, the last US polio patient using an iron lung, marks the end of an era.

- **[We Know Simple Fluids Can Flow. Turns Out, Some Can Fracture](https://www.quantamagazine.org/we-know-simple-fluids-can-flow-turns-out-some-can-fracture-20260710/)** – Quanta reports on new research showing that under certain conditions, simple liquids can develop cracks. This has implications for materials science and everyday phenomena like inkjet printing.
- **[What xAI's Grok Build CLI Actually Sends to xAI](https://gist.github.com/cereblab/dc9a40bc26120f4540e4e09b75ffb547)** – A developer reverse-engineered the Grok CLI and found it transmits metadata much more than claimed. With 129 points and 69 comments, this is a growing privacy scandal for xAI.
- **[Why Write Code in 2026](https://softwaredoug.com/blog/2026/07/09/write-code.html)** – A reflective essay questioning the role of human programmers as AI code generation improves. The conversation on HN is split between ‘AI as tool’ and ‘AI as replacement.’
- **[Small Inventors Are Being Squeezed by a Convoluted Patent Process](https://www.nationalreview.com/news/small-inventors-are-being-squeezed-by-a-convoluted-patent-process/)** – A National Review piece on how rising fees and legal complexity are drowning independent inventors. Relevant to startups and makers in the hardware space.
- **[A dock that wakes up reliably](https://fabiensanglard.net/tb4/index.html)** – Fabien Sanglard’s technical deep-dive into designing a Thunderbolt 4 dock that always wakes from sleep. Practical engineering advice that resonated with 48 points and 37 comments.

**Signal to watch**: The xAI CLI story could snowball—if more data surfaces, it may trigger a broader audit of developer tool telemetry. Also, the fluid fracture discovery might lead to new patents in manufacturing.

AI.zh:
2-3 句概览：AI 行业周末不平静。OpenAI 安全负责人离职（第六位），安全团队被并入研究部门；同时旧金山爆发「美国历史上最大AI抗议」，数百人游行至 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google DeepMind 门口。Anthropic 则发布 Claude 内部推理空间的惊人发现，并获马斯克「当前 AI 领跑者」的背书。

- [OpenAI Loses Sixth Safety Leader in Two Years, Folds Team Into Research](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNQlJGZTVudUg3Y21kWHItX2M3YnlOcHVKV3lPbkR6QzlkZUxRUjdMOWQxazRWZ3N4OV9zMXNkaTQ2dkNnZUFzbEYwQk82WEVsbE9JZC04aEIzd1RBX2czX01tWS1MdXVjTjBiZWtOQWZ0ZzV5YUFNamJOZUM3cjZiWTE5RVlSSTNXcnkxeGFFR29uS3doZTM0NFQ2cnhqREFtakl0WFBrRGZKX3F3bzFBSzhMUkRLUmdB) — OpenAI 再次失去安全负责人，团队被合并入研究部，意味着安全审查与研发的界限进一步模糊。
- [Largest AI protest in American history sees hundreds march on downtown San Francisco](https://news.google.) — 抗议者要求「停止AI竞赛」，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 办公室被包围，事件标志着公众对 AI 风险的焦虑达到新高度。
- [Anthropic found a hidden space where Claude puzzles over concepts](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/09/1140293/anthropic-found-a-hidden-space-where-claude-puzzles-over-concepts/) — Anthropic 使用「Jacobian 透镜」工具首次清晰观察到 Claude 模型内部的「概念推理空间」，发现模型在回答前会进行类似沉思的过程，为可解释性提供突破口。
- [Musk Backs Anthropic as Today’s AI Front-Runner](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOVmNRYS1XSGk4bHFOLXVMa3ZUcHBIYTNTTzJLUUR6Wk1mT2tkVzZUMmhtZ0ZlRTJFZm1MR09wQjJFcm1SM0hvZzdqN2FlOThNejFQQk02cWNhVFREcWpiRGFjN1NuaEVCbnhIUGtOd3kwUEg5ZFFZYzVBN0hxMHpuMWtDMA) — 马斯克公开表示 Anthropic 当前领先，结合他此前对 OpenAI 的批评，显示 AI 行业力量重组。
- [Phoebe Gates' AI shopping app Phia reportedly claimed unearned affiliate sales through fake clicks](https://www.engadget.com/2212973/phoebe-gates-ai-shopping-app-phia-affiliate-sales-fake-clicks/) — 比尔·盖茨之女的 AI 购物应用 Phia 被指通过虚假点击赚取联盟佣金，为 AI 电商的诚信蒙上阴影。

收束判断：AI 行业正经历「安全-速度」的根本矛盾：OpenAI 牺牲安全换取研发整合，而公众抗议与内部人员出走形成双重压力；Anthropic 则凭借透明化研究赢得口碑，马斯克的背书可能加速资本流向。
AI.en:
AI news today was dominated by public protest and internal instability. Hundreds marched in San Francisco against OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind, demanding a halt to the AI race—the largest such protest in US history. At the same time, OpenAI lost its head of safety (the sixth leader to leave in two years) and folded the team into research, raising questions about its commitment to safe deployment. A think tank report found the global AI industry falls short on safety standards. On the product side, OpenAI is hiring a product manager for family-oriented ChatGPT features, and Anthropic reportedly held talks with Sydney Sweeney, signaling a push into 'culture' marketing. Separately, an AI tool discovered a 15-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability, and Reed Jobs (Steve's son) discussed using AI for cancer drug discovery.

- **[Largest AI protest in American history sees hundreds march on downtown San Francisco](https://news.google.)** – Multiple outlets covered the march. This is a clear escalation in public opposition, and policymakers may take note.
- **[OpenAI Loses Sixth Safety Leader in Two Years, Folds Team Into Research](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNQlJGZTVudUg3Y21kWHItX2M3YnlOcHVKV3lPbkR6QzlkZUxRUjdMOWQxazRWZ3N4OV9zMXNkaTQ2dkNnZUFzbEYwQk82WEVsbE9JZC04aEIzd1RBX2czX01tWS1MdXVjTjBiZWtOQWZ0ZzV5YUFNamJOZUM3cjZiWTE5RVlSSTNXcnkxeGFFR29uS3doZTM0NFQ2cnhqREFtakl0WFBrRGZKX3F3bzFBSzhMUkRLUmdB)** – This structural change weakens independent safety oversight within OpenAI. The timing amid protests is damaging.
- **[AI Found a Root Bug in Linux That Everyone Missed for 15 Years](https://www.wired.com/story/security-news-this-week-ai-found-a-root-bug-in-linux-that-everyone-missed-for-15-years/)** – A double-edged story: AI as a powerful security tool, but also a reminder of how many latent vulnerabilities exist.
- **[OpenAI bets on families as ChatGPT goes deeper into households](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/11/openai-bets-on-families-as-chatgpt-goes-deeper-into-households/)** – The job posting for a family-focused product manager signals a push into consumer home markets, likely in parallel with the protest backlash.
- **[Musk Backs Anthropic as Today’s AI Front-Runner](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxOVmNRYS1XSGk4bHFOLXVMa3ZUcHBIYTNTTzJLUUR6Wk1mT2tkVzZUMmhtZ0ZlRTJFZm1MR09wQjJFcm1SM0hvZzdqN2FlOThNejFQQk02cWNhVFREcWpiRGFjN1NuaEVCbnhIUGtOd3kwUEg5ZFFZYzVBN0hxMHpuMWtDMA)** – A surprising endorsement from Elon Musk, who has his own AI ambitions. Could signal a realignment in the AI landscape.

**Signal to watch**: The protest movement may accelerate regulatory action. Also, OpenAI's family push could face resistance if safety concerns remain unaddressed.

汽车.zh:
2-3 句概览：特斯拉Cybercab 的「员工接送」计划被拆穿——实际只是在工厂停车场绕圈，并非真正的自动驾驶出行服务。另一边，Oregon 推出电动自行车/滑板车举报系统以应对乱象，BYD 最畅销电动车迎来大小和外观的升级。

- [Tesla claims Cybercab driving employees at Giga Texas — in a parking lot](https://electrek.co/2026/07/11/tesla-cybercab-giga-texas-parking-lot/) — 特斯拉宣布「Cybercab 员工体验即将开始」，但实际内容是在得州超级工厂停车场内接送员工，距离路测和商业运营仍有巨大差距。Electrek 指出这一宣传「比听起来单薄得多」。
- [Another state adds a way to report reckless e-bike and e-scooter riders](https://electrek.co/2026/07/11/another-state-adds-a-way-to-report-reckless-e-bike-and-e-scooter-riders/) — Oregon 警长办公室推出在线举报平台，旨在识别电动单车/滑板车危险行驶热点，这是继加州等地后又一个州采取类似措施，反映城市微出行管理从放任转向监管。
- [BYD’s most popular EV gets an upgrade in looks and size](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxQUjVQZjVIb2pYdWNGVW43VWYwb2EzcENwb0E3RU1aYTU3UGd3NjQ3aXNldnEzenhpWllJamdaeFF5YTZ6V1g3cVQ3U2pxNk4xZmxOMTZ1X2VVak9hTlpyQ3JSY1hJN05hV1JXU1dMcExmUHVFcER4RkNLa09sMzZGbjNFaFAyMEMzVTBBX1N0Wnc) — BYD Atto 3（元Plus海外版）迎来中期改款，尺寸加大、设计更新，意图巩固其在全球紧凑型电动车市场的地位。

收束判断：特斯拉的「Robotaxi 叙事」仍在原地踏步，宣传与实际的鸿沟可能消耗投资者耐心；而微出行和主流电动车的增量改进才是当前汽车科技的实际推进方向。
汽车.en:
Today's automotive tech news centers on Tesla's ambiguous Cybercab rollout and growing regulation of e-bikes. Tesla claimed 'employee rides' are starting soon at Giga Texas, but details are sparse—likely just shuttling workers around the parking lot rather than a true robo-taxi service. Meanwhile, another state (Oregon) introduced a reporting system for reckless e-bike and e-scooter riders, reflecting the ongoing regulatory scramble as micromobility grows. On the EV front, BYD updated its most popular model with improved aesthetics and dimensions, signaling continued pressure on Tesla's market share.

- **[Tesla claims Cybercab driving employees at Giga Texas — in a parking lot](https://electrek.co/2026/07/11/tesla-cybercab-giga-texas-parking-lot/)** – Electrek’s analysis suggests the announcement is mostly hype. Without a clear timeline for real public rides, the stock may not react positively.
- **[Another state adds a way to report reckless e-bike and e-scooter riders](https://electrek.co/2026/07/11/another-state-adds-a-way-to-report-reckless-e-bike-and-e-scooter-riders/)** – Oregon's approach follows similar moves in California and New York. Expect more municipalities to adopt reporting tools as e-bike injuries rise.
- **[BYD’s most popular EV gets an upgrade in looks and size](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxQUjVQZjVIb2pYdWNGVW43VWYwb2EzcENwb0E3RU1aYTU3UGd3NjQ3aXNldnEzenhpWllJamdaeFF5YTZ6V1g3cVQ3U2pxNk4xZmxOMTZ1X2VVak9hTlpyQ3JSY1hJN05hV1JXU1dMcExmUHVFcER4RkNLa09sMzZGbjNFaFAyMEMzVTBBX1N0Wnc)** – The redesign of BYD's best-seller could further erode Tesla's dominance in China and emerging markets.

**Signal to watch**: Tesla’s Cybercab demo week could either prove skeptics wrong or confirm that full autonomy is still far off. Also, monitor e-bike reporting data—it could shape future sidewalk bans or licensing requirements.

篮球.zh:
NBA休赛期进入高潮，文班亚马创历史续约，莫兰特交易和热火内讧引爆舆论。黄蜂送走鲍尔标志重建，雄鹿4年6400万留住特伦特。NBPA炮轰奢侈税制度，劳资博弈升温。

- [文班亚马5年2.52亿顶薪续约马刺](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328757/sources-spurs-victor-wembanyama-reach-252-million-max-extension)，为球队未来核心奠定基础。
- [莫兰特称加盟开拓者“重新开始”，否认“恶人”形象](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49335942/ja-morant-says-joining-trail-blazers-starting-all-again)。
- [阿德巴约与希罗在拉斯维加斯训练中发生肢体冲突](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328387/heat-bam-adebayo-bucks-tyler-herro-got-physical-altercation-las-vegas)，热火内部矛盾激化。
- [黄蜂GM称交易鲍尔为“多目标”考量](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337303/ball-trade-help-hornets-compete-championships)，未来选秀权或成关键。
- [NBPA执董：第二奢侈税线令球员和球迷利益受损](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49329997/nbpa-players-carrying-burden-teams-due-second-apron)。

当前市场仍存变数，莱昂纳德下家、勒布朗抉择将主导后续走势。
篮球.en:
A dramatic NBA offseason continues, headlined by Victor Wembanyama's record extension and a violent altercation between former Heat stars. Teams are reshaping rosters while the league's financial rules face backlash. The Las Vegas Summer League also provided standout performances.

- **Wembanyama Locked In**: The Spurs secured their future with a [five-year, $252 million max extension](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328757/sources-spurs-victor-wembanyama-reach-252-million-max-extension) for Victor Wembanyama, making him the centerpiece of their rebuild.
- **Shocking Altercation**: [Bam Adebayo struck Tyler Herro](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328387/heat-bam-adebayo-bucks-tyler-herro-got-physical-altercation-las-vegas) in a Las Vegas practice court fight, highlighting tension between the former Heat teammates now on different teams.
- **Ja Morant's New Chapter**: After the trade to Portland, Morant expressed relief and a desire to ["start fresh"](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49335942/ja-morant-says-joining-trail-blazers-starting-all-again), aiming to change his public image.
- **Gary Trent Jr. Stays with Bucks**: Trent agreed to a [four-year, $64 million deal](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337401/gary-trent-jr-agrees-4-year-64m-deal-stay-bucks) to remain in Milwaukee, solidifying their backcourt.
- **Summer League Spotlight**: Bulls rookie Caleb Wilson scored [35 points in his debut](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49330697/bulls-wilson-emotional-puts-show-35-point-summer-league-debut), the second-most in Las Vegas Summer League history.

Look for the NBPA's pushback against the second apron to gain momentum, and watch how the Hornets and Trail Blazers leverage their new assets from the Ball and Morant trades.

足球.zh:
世界杯四强诞生两席：英格兰加时2-1挪威，贝林厄姆双响救主；阿根廷1-0瑞士，阿尔瓦雷斯加时绝杀。场外事件：南非中场杰登·亚当斯25岁去世；切尔西标价5000万欧清洗加纳乔；意大利请马尔蒂尼任技术总监重建。

- [贝林厄姆两球率英格兰逆转挪威，图赫尔赛后批评球队“幸运”](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49338957/jude-bellingham-england-thomas-tuchel-criticism)。
- [阿根廷加时1-0瑞士，阿尔瓦雷斯一击制胜](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49339687/argentina-switzerland-2026-world-cup-julian-alvarez-england)。
- [南非中场杰登·亚当斯去世，年仅25岁](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49333373/south-africa-midfielder-jayden-adams-dies-aged-25-weeks-world-cup-appearance)。
- [切尔西欲清洗加纳乔，要价5000万欧](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49334998/chelsea-prioritise-exit-wantaway-alejandro-garnacho-sources)。
- [意大利足协聘马尔蒂尼为技术总监，莱昂纳多为顾问](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49336670/italy-tap-paolo-maldini-leonardo-technical-director-advisor-roles)。

半决赛英阿大战引人注目，贝林厄姆与梅西的直接对话将决定冠军走势。
足球.en:
The World Cup quarterfinals delivered high drama, with England and Argentina advancing amid controversy and tragedy. Meanwhile, Italy begins a major rebuild and Chelsea moves to offload a disgruntled star.

- **England Survive Norway Scare**: [Jude Bellingham's double](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49337503/jude-bellingham-england-norway-world-cup-quarterfinal-semifinals) lifted England to a 2-1 extra-time win, but manager Thomas Tuchel was angry at the performance, calling it ["lucky" and "sloppy"](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ckg474ekv58o). Bellingham defended his teammates' fighting spirit.
- **Spidercam Controversy**: Norway claims the ball hit an overhead camera wire before Bellingham's equalizer, but [FIFA found no evidence](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49337953/england-norway-world-cup-goal-ball-camera-cable-jude-bellingham), though a Snicko-like test was inconclusive.
- **Argentina Edge Switzerland**: [Julián Álvarez scored in extra time](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49339687/argentina-switzerland-2026-world-cup-julian-alvarez-england) to set up a semifinal against England, defending their title.
- **Tragedy: Jayden Adams Dies at 25**: South Africa midfielder [Jayden Adams passed away](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49333373/south-africa-midfielder-jayden-adams-dies-aged-25-weeks-world-cup-appearance), a week after playing in the World Cup, shocking the football world.
- **Italy Hires Maldini and Leonardo**: The FIGC appointed [Paolo Maldini as technical director and Leonardo as advisor](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49336670/italy-tap-paolo-maldini-leonardo-technical-director-advisor-roles) to rebuild the national team after missing the World Cup.

Keep an eye on the England-Argentina semifinal and whether the spidercam debate influences future goal-line technology. Also, Chelsea's stance on Alejandro Garnacho could spark a transfer battle.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑社区焦点集中在世界杯英格兰vs挪威的判罚争议与贝林厄姆神迹，同时CBA新赛季奖项与青训故事引发讨论。球迷对VAR评分、点球取消等话题激烈争论。

- [VAR给裁判蒂尔潘打2.5分，两次重大失误致评分最低](https://news.google.)。
- [贝林厄姆两场2球创世界杯纪录，仅次于贝利](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOTnlSNUNSTHZWUE1SbXBjQWlxWWl0XzhUdDU5WktacE5RN2pLblJNTmJNQjAzWEs3QVVtOVc0Sk5lOU9BSGlRT0xSQVIwQzRVZEF3V3V5RVEta1RpMFlJYVJpQy1ad3JGUWVUQ0Q2MFhHVGxMbjE0NmRpQzRvbElKVFZaVlh4LWZvRVEzcHlkSmZxQQ)。
- [英格兰挪威加时赛点球争议，VAR介入后取消](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNb3liSjJVMHl2ZlozcUloaUxTR3JhdFV4bzFsYXM2OXhVUHctRGU1UmVTS2JTbkl4ZWVNQlhzVndNaEFPeF9ObS1ITnVRRWRBaldoUHlISUlrbGNxMTVoS1FCcV9NSEMyc2xOMXdhVVFqbGotRjNHVHNtWkxjSEFFUEw2OGlBa3RVQTVEZWJRSlZndw)。
- [凯恩国家队120场追平鲁尼，并列队史第二](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOcnZ1anBEOENEUEpoSjg4QUJBOG04OTZ2cGotTVJrMmtDdGRkOEVxME5JMlFqcV9GOGVDUFBDRDY2VFExN3Fyc2ZTeHoxOHVPVllPUTdPeHAwRnpSOHo3aUJhYjY2TlNMOHVlTDdnM0V4QTFKVzU4YU5hQVJBNWFnN2NnWDZvemJSczNyZ0ktNXNZZw)。
- [赖斯青训秘辛曝光：每周三次魔鬼训练](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5Na3VQVUVLZUdlUURiMUxVWWtnZXhmS0xHUnhKSDBRdWktMUU4WUF3SW9zS25zVEdwVThmRldaUEVmbjh4WlhxOTlGV3AzMVF4RnFQbXlNMTZkUl9ycDZPN190aEtwQVFFSm1aSUk3LVByZw)。

社区情绪偏向支持英格兰，但判罚公正性成为质疑焦点，后续半决赛裁判安排可能再引热议。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Chinese fan communities are buzzing with World Cup analysis, VAR criticism, and player milestones. Key discussions focus on Bellingham's record, Kane's achievement, and controversy from the England-Norway match.

- **VAR Under Fire**: Official VAR rating gave referee [Tillpan a 2.5 score](https://news.google.) due to two major mistakes, sparking debate on officiating standards.
- **Bellingham's Record**: Bellingham's [two goals in two World Cup knockout games](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOTnlSNUNSTHZWUE1SbXBjQWlxWWl0XzhUdDU5WktacE5RN2pLblJNTmJNQjAzWEs3QVVtOVc0Sk5lOU9BSGlRT0xSQVIwQzRVZEF3V3V5RVEta1RpMFlJYVJpQy1ad3JGUWVUQ0Q2MFhHVGxMbjE0NmRpQzRvbElKVFZaVlh4LWZvRVEzcHlkSmZxQQ) puts him second only to Pelé in history for the feat, per Chinese media.
- **Penalty Controversy**: A late extra-time penalty for Norway [was overturned after VAR review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNb3liSjJVMHl2ZlozcUloaUxTR3JhdFV4bzFsYXM2OXhVUHctRGU1UmVTS2JTbkl4ZWVNQlhzVndNaEFPeF9ObS1ITnVRRWRBaldoUHlISUlrbGNxMTVoS1FCcV9NSEMyc2xOMXdhVVFqbGotRjNHVHNtWkxjSEFFUEw2OGlBa3RVQTVEZWJRSlZndw), leading to heated fan arguments.
- **Kane Ties Rooney**: Harry Kane's [120th England cap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOcnZ1anBEOENEUEpoSjg4QUJBOG04OTZ2cGotTVJrMmtDdGRkOEVxME5JMlFqcV9GOGVDUFBDRDY2VFExN3Fyc2ZTeHoxOHVPVllPUTdPeHAwRnpSOHo3aUJhYjY2TlNMOHVlTDdnM0V4QTFKVzU4YU5hQVJBNWFnN2NnWDZvemJSczNyZ0ktNXNZZw) tied Wayne Rooney for second all-time, celebrated in fan forums.

Chinese basketball fans are also discussing Yang Hanshen's tactical awareness and Whiteside's doping case, but the World Cup dominates community sentiment. Expect continued debate on VAR and Bellingham's legacy as the semifinal approaches.

欧美.zh: Jay-Z于洋基球场举办《The Blueprint》25周年纪念秀，请来Eminem、Pharrell Williams和Slick Rick助阵，但90分钟短时设定让观众意犹未尽（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/jay-z-celebrates-the-blueprint-eminem-pharrell-slick-rick-1236807102/)）。同天，《Big Brother 28》首播因火山坠落恶搞桥段引发批评，Frankie Grande发文辩护称“坎普是节目DNA的一部分”（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/big-brother-28-premiere-frankie-grande-defends-1236980027/)）。Patti LuPone的同志游轮再度遭埃及拒入，距土耳其拒载仅隔十日（[Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/patti-lupones-gay-cruise-blocked-egypt-1236644606/)）。Jack White新专《Frozen Charlotte》被评“No Name 2.0”，摇滚火力不减（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/album-reviews/jack-white-frozen-charlotte-album-revew-1236807326/)）。《Love Island USA》选手Corbin谈论“羞辱性”淘汰及绰号“CorbinGPT”（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/features/love-island-usa-corbin-elimination-corbingpt-sincere-melanie-movie-night-1236806166/)）。欧美娱乐仍以综艺与演唱会为双引擎，但争议与政治阻力渐显。
欧美.en:
The US entertainment desk is buzzing with live event nostalgia and award season positioning. Jay-Z's carefully curated anniversary show, the Emmy forecast, and reality TV drama are the leading stories.
- **[Jay-Z’s ‘Blueprint’ Anniversary Show](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/jay-z-celebrates-the-blueprint-eminem-pharrell-slick-rick-1236807102/)** — Guests were high-profile but the set was deliberately short, possibly signaling a shift toward album-focused concerts over lengthy encores.
- **[Emmy Roundtable](https://variety.com/2026/tv/awards/emmy-nominations-roundtable-the-pitt-hacks-podcast-1236807336/)** — The dominance of 'The Pitt' and 'Hacks' suggests the TV academy is rewarding consistent critical and commercial success; dark horses could shake up categories.
- **[Big Brother 28 Premiere Defended](https://deadline.com/2026/07/big-brother-28-premiere-frankie-grande-defends-1236980027/)** — Frankie Grande pushed back against criticism, arguing that campy elements are core to the show's identity.
- **[Love Island USA Corbin Elimination](https://variety.com/2026/tv/features/love-island-usa-corbin-elimination-corbingpt-sincere-melanie-movie-night-1236806166/)** — Corbin's 'humiliating' exit and the 'CorbinGPT' nickname reflect the show's evolving social dynamics.
- **[Patti LuPone’s Gay Cruise Blocked from Egypt Again](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/patti-lupones-gay-cruise-blocked-egypt-1236644606/)** — This second denial highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions around LGBTQ+ visibility.
**Signal:** The Westies review suggests MGM+ is betting on period gangster dramas, but generic execution may limit breakout potential.

日韩.zh: SBS《Agent Kim Reactivated》第六集拿下22.3%全国收视率，仅次于同台历史最高纪录，收视曲线凌厉（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853878wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-earns-2nd-highest-ratings-of-any-friday-saturday-drama-in-sbs-history)）。JTBC新剧《The Apartment Job》首播即获4.6%收视拿下当日有线台冠军，对手《The Husband》同时段创新高（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853882wpp/the-apartment-job-premieres-to-no-1-ratings-as-the-husband-rises-to-new-saturday-high)）。IU确认Heo Nam Jun出演新专辑主打曲MV，二人继《德鲁纳酒店》后再度合作（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853885wpp/iu-and-heo-nam-jun-confirmed-to-reunite-for-her-upcoming-comeback-mv)）。BTS《Life Goes On》MV突破6亿次观看，成为团体第16支达成该里程碑的作品（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853862wpp/btss-life-goes-on-becomes-their-16th-group-mv-to-hit-600-million-views)）。七月品牌声誉排名：I.O.I登顶女团，BTS继续领跑男团（[Soompi女团](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853889wpp/july-girl-group-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8)、[男团](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853874wpp/july-boy-group-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-9)）。韩剧收视竞争白热化，IU回归进一步点燃下半年市场期待。
日韩.en:
K-pop and K-drama continue to dominate the Asian entertainment landscape. Brand reputation rankings and soaring viewership numbers underscore the strength of both industries.
- **[July Girl Group Reputation Rankings](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853889wpp/july-girl-group-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8)** — I.O.I rose to the top, reflecting renewed interest in project groups; the ranking uses big data from participation to community indexes.
- **[July Boy Group Reputation Rankings](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853874wpp/july-boy-group-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-9)** — BTS remains at the top, even during the members' military service, demonstrating enduring brand power.
- **[Agent Kim Reactivated Hits 22.3%](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853878wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-earns-2nd-highest-ratings-of-any-friday-saturday-drama-in-sbs-history)** — So Ji Sub's action drama is on a trajectory to break SBS's all-time record; next episode's 'divide and conquer' plot will likely sustain momentum.
- **[The Apartment Job Premiere](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853882wpp/the-apartment-job-premieres-to-no-1-ratings-as-the-husband-rises-to-new-saturday-high)** — Ji Sung's return to cable scores solid debut; competition with 'The Husband' on same night is intensifying.
- **[IU and Heo Nam Jun Reunite for MV](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853885wpp/iu-and-heo-nam-jun-confirmed-to-reunite-for-her-upcoming-comeback-mv)** — The pairing from 'The Producers' draws attention; IU's comeback is likely to dominate charts upon release.
**Signal:** With multiple dramas breaking ratings records, Korean broadcasters are successfully blending webtoon adaptations and star power.

中国.zh: “大陆演员无戏可演回家卖菜”话题发酵，经纪人杜华回应引发行业讨论（[大纪元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTFAzcUktM3pNMks2QmNMSWM3NGVWcXpnN1NNajlRYVB1bndmbkZLay1FZFBjODdRaUJPVjlUOFEtQVQ4eUdfMy0wdzJPVlBGczdkV3hjUWw0WEJKX1FibHd3MjgzSTlPQdIBZkFVX3lxTFAzcUktM3pNMks2QmNMSWM3NGVWcXpnN1NNajlRYVB1bndmbkZLay1FZFBjODdRaUJPVjlUOFEtQVQ4eUdfMy0wdzJPVlBGczdkV3hjUWw0WEJKX1FibHd3MjgzSTlPQQ)）。学者沈奕斐对话《不再崇拜明星的年轻人，到底在追什么？》切入饭圈文化变迁（[澎湃新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9RZThndDFLQnNsLXFmSUZGUzlOc2dtRGhnbmRONXpiaXpPN191aGdQblMxdlhHcG9lSmhSVWF1TlJDRnpvdjdJUEZpNGNfcU9iLXB0dTJPUG9LckxvU0E)）。日本籍演员矢野浩二因在广西洪灾中参与救援并捐款，口碑暴涨（[网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9FUGI5WmRzaUcxWGxENFFRVVpHQTFvUHY3V1ltSVVDRVJ0M043RWh1NWVJT1ctRENMbTFoLWdkUmxSRzFPa1dKVUluTVJ4R0tDNjg4YlRYQnJVY0xUcTh2cnRB)）。水军集团落网案公布，涉及张凌赫、迪丽热巴等多位明星，900万粉丝娱乐博主涉案（[8world](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxORGNfYnhRVE15SVZVSF9iU0dIZkgwaklLT0Fxb05oMXFlSWRoSUV5S1BBTWpWcmw0WkhDMFBYYkdoVzQxeUR4V2FkMXhabm9QeWE0YUJjS0ttdEpIMzhfSUNxVXlFNkF0akJKNG15dERhdHNDbTNqWUxaVW5tVzVuNVc5NGlRekxIUVFLc3RHTVVwdjlza1U2ZjRWdy1GX1pz)）。业界提出“深产片”概念，强调不单靠特效（[星岛头条](https://news.google.)）。中国娱乐业面临演员生存危机、饭圈乱象与内容升级的三重压力。
中国.en:
China's entertainment sector is grappling with industry contraction and regulatory interventions. Stories this cycle range from technology immersion to celebrity defamation crackdowns.
- **[Sony Expo at BilibiliWorld](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPOEhKczAweG9tdDlySkR3Y1V4aFE2NS1yX21ZajQteWNaMVl3VnhJY1Y4UGV2V2ZOa0ZLVlE2Vk9VZVVfazVTWU9XQmRHQ1owRElqaUhNWlB2WHVTUW1uREt4dGdtcmZoS0pnMkZaY3J3aXN6SDBTN3JyT3RNeUE1MFFLdGNMYXdUcElTNVJYenVTZ1d1UUZ4Y3pXbw)** — Sony's third consecutive appearance shows a push to blend hardware and IP for immersive entertainment, targeting Gen Z.
- **[Actors Returning to Farming](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTFAzcUktM3pNMks2QmNMSWM3NGVWcXpnN1NNajlRYVB1bndmbkZLay1FZFBjODdRaUJPVjlUOFEtQVQ4eUdfMy0wdzJPVlBGczdkV3hjUWw0WEJKX1FibHd3MjgzSTlPQdIBZkFVX3lxTFAzcUktM3pNMks2QmNMSWM3NGVWcXpnN1NNajlRYVB1bndmbkZLay1FZFBjODdRaUJPVjlUOFEtQVQ4eUdfMy0wdzJPVlBGczdkV3hjUWw0WEJKX1FibHd3MjgzSTlPQQ)** — Agent Du Hua's response to the phenomenon of actors having no roles and selling vegetables highlights the oversupply in the industry.
- **[Water Army Crackdown](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxORGNfYnhRVE15SVZVSF9iU0dIZkgwaklLT0Fxb05oMXFlSWRoSUV5S1BBTWpWcmw0WkhDMFBYYkdoVzQxeUR4V2FkMXhabm9QeWE0YUJjS0ttdEpIMzhfSUNxVXlFNkF0akJKNG15dERhdHNDbTNqWUxaVW5tVzVuNVc5NGlRekxIUVFLc3RHTVVwdjlza1U2ZjRWdy1GX1pz)** — Arrest of a network that targeted Zhang Linghe and Dilraba shows authorities are serious about curbing online defamation.
- **[Discussion on Celebrity Worship](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9RZThndDFLQnNsLXFmSUZGUzlOc2dtRGhnbmRONXpiaXpPN191aGdQblMxdlhHcG9lSmhSVWF1TlJDRnpvdjdJUEZpNGNfcU9iLXB0dTJPUG9LckxvU0E)** — Sociologist Shen Yifei's analysis notes young people are shifting from worship to fandom, reflecting deeper cultural changes.
- **[Deep Production Films](https://news.google.)** — An opinion piece argues that 'deep production films' are rising in China, relying on more than just visual effects.
**Signal:** The balance between state regulation and market freedom will define the next phase of Chinese entertainment; the water army case could set a precedent.

微博社区动态.zh: 虞书欣新剧《百花杀》开播前云包场1120个座位，获“半个娱乐圈”转发助阵，预约破350万（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE92dEtGWUlCSDVvZ3dWTlpIX2xJeXVJVklmY05JSjZrcHp6NkRNNmloODFBRVZxRjBTa0JkNDM1bExPdzRrRWhIeW85dVNHMEZLamlhR081eDJFSEJDOUgySjFBb09zczZCNFpLci1oZnZjQQ)）。卢昱晓打破常规高调为侯明昊包场，引发“友谊还是营业”讨论（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE55QUliTndaQk1KNDBpd1FUSENWM1pSOXpaSEYxcFlxclpXTjdGTkdWT0RaOTctZ2JEWUllTG1QUVlYSGs1UmRKamhCdGVERU9yVnA3cG5fVXdQdWNzbmZiNThXTVAwTXg1bHZCaGhsTWs)）。董思成改微博名暗示十年合约到期正式独立（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxObkhGV2R3ZEJZSGFXNHRxdDU0LWhPRFdtQUVkbkR0UHdNMmJObzJmQkJUNV83QXJ3cWIxZC1vckZfMVR1SkdKN1ROTXktb2NYa0RqWXNxTnBsMndoT1VHVmNXV1htelpuU0N4VWMwNmVxNjZKNmU2V2RxRmJvbUQ5WjNySnlaMnM)）。《功夫女足》票房破2亿但“难看”登上热搜，周星驰谢票坦言怕辜负观众（[Sin Chew Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE8xclQ0QlM3TnlHenp6cHBfSUFHRGFuaVVGeEdDcDcxeU1QUmxMNlc0NmxKUkZrcGZYaUhSWWZPdl9TMDA2NXdISDE4UHBRSl93UUFYQXB3NUhveURPRlp6NF84Q1NtQU9tRUVXMkZsOA)）。《千香》扑街被批“塑料演技”，粉丝刷热搜也无济于事（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9hOFFTZGNVdDA5alB5QTJIWmVVUlVWdUQ5Y0V3VEx3N3dLM1IzX3FCelJ6bldlbzJtUGdwRlliZWk2OTM5LXFzNG1CSEFYRmM)）。微博话题仍是剧集宣发主战场，但口碑与流量脱钩趋势愈发明显。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo is ablaze with drama premieres, celebrity independence moves, and viral oddities. The launch of '百花杀' and the backlash against '千香' dominate conversation, alongside personal milestones.
- **[千香 Flop Criticism](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9hOFFTZGNVdDA5alB5QTJIWmVVUlVWdUQ5Y0V3VEx3N3dLM1IzX3FCelJ6bldlbzJtUGdwRlliZWk2OTM5LXFzNG1CSEFYRmM)** — Despite fan efforts to trend it, '千香' is being panned for poor acting; this highlights the gap between online hype and real reception.
- **[功夫女足 Box Office 200M & Controversy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTFA3cXNnbVZSTkwtcTB0UVAtNXZTZmdKWlJhQmRUTExCZkE2STFwMTB3bFRlSGwwanhrQlV2YzNFQWZWY2hrVzdZZUNINm95VXNwRkU4Mmx0Y3MwOGNZdVozeTBJbERYRHVaOTMwbnJYcHlPVWs)** — Zhou Xingchi's (Stephen Chow) film is a commercial success but critically divisive; he apologized for fearing to disappoint audiences.
- **[虞书欣 Cloud Screening for 百花杀](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE5NX2FSQk1qdGszTnFKczdhdkhmZ3I1SkhlVW56NXpFLTM4cUp4XzZHWE1VQ3Q1WHFsVUdxSnNlU2xZNTdkLXRmR1I3cDFoSzV1bGxjUzFDcjZtdDFrUnQ2TG5FX1JPRWNvWW92QWJGSE5RMFk)** — Yu Shuxin mobilized dozens of celebrities for a 'cloud screening', a novel marketing tactic that drove 350M pre-release reservations.
- **[董思成 Leaves SM After 10 Years](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxObkhGV2R3ZEJZSGFXNHRxdDU0LWhPRFdtQUVkbkR0UHdNMmJObzJmQkJUNV83QXJ3cWIxZC1vckZfMVR1SkdKN1ROTXktb2NYa0RqWXNxTnBsMndoT1VHVmNXV1htelpuU0N4VWMwNmVxNjZKNmU2V2RxRmJvbUQ5WjNySnlaMnM)** — The actor changed his Weibo handle and officially went independent, marking a major shift in K-pop/Chinese crossover careers.
- **[王俊凯 Foam Pants](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1IRzBjZmE0aHpOQXBaUHptOGpwQWNJMXZ1TjcwaFY1cGtldlJ1cndnM2ZiLXlyeTBSQW1BUnNVTVZGdWdiX3lVTWJqZlJDaUxKMDVuM2tQWlZwSk9TeEJKRF82dTVnNXBRV1gxazRzbWQ)** — A seemingly trivial moment (pants covered in foam) trended, demonstrating fan base power to amplify any moment.
**Signal:** The success of '百花杀' will test whether celebrity-driven cloud screenings become a new norm; also watch for post-'千香' fallout on casting decisions.
